Title: Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production
text: 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production To Read Chinese Version A press conference of the State Councils joint prevention and control mechanism for the novel coronavirus pneumonia outbreak was held at 10 a.m. on Saturday, February 15, 2020. At the conference, Fan Yifei, Deputy Governor of the Peoples Bank of China(PBC), Liang Tao, Vice Chairman of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission(CBIRC), Yan Qingmin, Vice Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission(CSRC), and Xuan Changneng, Deputy Administrator of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange(SAFE) were invited to introduce the endeavors of the financial system in overcoming the difficulties and providing quality services to fully support anti-epidemic efforts and production restart, and to answer questions from the press. Selected transcript is as follows. (This English version only covers the speech and answers of PBC Deputy Governor Fan Yifei.) Fan Yifei: 3688110/3688175/3974303/index.html 1/10 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production Dear friends from the media, good morning! Recently, colleagues from the press have braved the risks and shouldered their missions to deliver in-depth interviews and reports on epidemic containment from the front. On behalf of the Peoples Bank of China, I would extend our gratitude to everyone for your hard work and long-term support for the financial work. Since the outbreak of the epidemic, the PBC has resolutely implemented the important instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping and followed the specific arrangements of the Leading Group of CPC Central Committee on the prevention and control of the novel coronavirus pneumonia (NCP) outbreak, adhering to people-centered approach and taking epidemic control and restart of production as an overriding political task by introducing all-out efforts and targeted policies. Cooperating with a variety of authorities, we have rolled out a series of policies and measures to fully support the epidemic containment and the restart of corporate production. Regarding the macro policies, the PBC and the CBIRC made elaborate introductions at the previous press conference. Today I will focus on financial services including payment and settlement, money supply, and financial infrastructure operation, as well as our efforts to support the restart of production as soon as possible. I. Opening green channels for payment and settlement to ensure timely fund transfers First of all, efforts have been made in fund transfers. The PBC High-Value Payment System (HVPS) is normally suspended during the Spring Festival. This year, in order to meet the need of epidemic prevention and control, the PBC deliberately opened a green channel for large-value transfers, and lifted the cap on the Bulk Electronic Payment System (BEPS) during the Spring Festival and on weekends after the holiday, aiming to satisfy the needs for the remittance of large funds at home and abroad. From January 24 to February 14, the HVPS and the BEPS processed a total of 393.5 thousand transactions of 3688110/3688175/3974303/index.html 2/10 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production payment above RMB10 million, amounting to RMB77.37 trillion in value. In particular, 872 payments were related to the containment of the epidemic, totaling RMB44.796 billion. At the same time, the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) has also opened a special channel for cross-border payments. Since February 3, we have extended the operation period of the HVPS in an attempt to serve the needs of interbank market transactions and the special central bank lending of the PBC. With regard to bank account services, a green channel for institutional bank accounts related to epidemic control was established. For special fiscal allocations, special emergency and resolution funds and other items that need to open authorized bank accounts, we took a case-specific and prompt approach. Meanwhile, bank account businesses were optimized in terms of accounts related to epidemic control. For those that temporarily lack the complete documents needed for account opening certification, commercial banks may issue certificates first and allow the documents to be collected later, on the condition that the applicants' identities can be verified.In addition, we have improved service efficiency and guided enterprises and individuals to handle payment, settlement and account-related businesses online. 2. Strengthening cash supply and circulation management, and effectively ensuring the safety of cash use First, we have adopted special measures for cash supply in Hubei Province, which is severely afflicted. Prior to the Spring Festival, the PBC immediately allocated RMB4 billion of new banknotes to Wuhan to reinforce cash supply for key institutions engaged in epidemic containment such as hospitals. Second, all branches of the PBC are required to fully secure cash supply, and to put new banknotes or issued funds withdrawn before the outbreak into circulation as their first choice. Third, efforts were made to disinfect the cash in circulation, and to deposit cash from key institutions temporarily in vaults. Meanwhile, intra-provincial cash transportation in some severely affected areas and inter-provincial cash transportation were suspended 3688110/3688175/3974303/index.html 3/10 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production to reduce virus transmission. Fourth, all commercial banks are required to strictly separate cash for payments from cash received. The latter must be disinfected before being released to clients again. 3. Ensuring the continuous and safe operation of fintech and key financial infrastructure In the wake of the epidemic, the PBC has launched an emergency plan in time to strengthen key infrastructure of the financial system, and to guarantee operations and maintenance support and around-the -clock emergency duty for key positions. At present, key financial infrastructure such as payment and clearing, treasury management, currency issuance, credit reference systems, accounting, and financial market custody clearing are operated in a safe and stable manner. Financial markets including interbank bond market, foreign exchange market, commercial papers market, and gold market are functioning normally. The technical support capabilities and emergency mechanisms of the financial sector have stood the test. At the same time, financial infrastructure institutions, commercial banks, and non-bank payment institutions have actively cut fees and reduced charges for payment and settlement. Shanghai Clearing House, Shanghai Gold Exchange, China Central Depository & Clearing Co., Ltd., and Shanghai Commercial Paper Exchange Corporation Ltd. have reduced or exempted fees for more than 20 items. China UnionPay has waived service fees for hospitals and charities involved in epidemic control nationwide, and refunded their service charges proportionately for micro and small merchants that use UnionPay QR code. China Nets Union Clearing Corporation has exempted non-profit medical institutions and charities nationwide from network service fees of bar code collection and settlement payments. Fifteen national commercial banks have waived handling fees for all donations to the fight against the epidemic. Tenpay and Alipay have exempted non-profit medical institutions from merchant fees, and reduced or waived commissions for courier and takeaway businesses. 3688110/3688175/3974303/index.html 4/10 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production In this battle of epidemic containment, many party members, cadres and staff of the PBC and various financial institutions have overcome difficulties to stay on their posts. They gallantly dedicated themselves to providing financial support for implementing the epidemic control policy timely, helping enterprises restart operation and production quickly, and securing basic financial services for the people. At present, the battle has reached the most critical stage. The PBC must live up to the hopes of the party and the people, resolutely implement the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core, and effectively implement the 30 financial support measures for epidemic prevention and control. We will support qualified enterprises restarting production as soon as possible, maintain smooth economic operation, minimize the impacts of the epidemic, and work hard to achieve the goals and tasks set by the CPC Central Committee. Thank you! Journalist with the Economic Daily: I have a question about cash use for Deputy Governor Fan Yifei. There have been rumors recently that cash may spread viruses. How does the PBC ensure that the cash we use is safe and sanitary? The epidemic has also made everyone appreciate the convenience of non-cash payments. How will mobile payments play a role in supporting peoples livelihood in the future? Thank you. Fan Yifei: In the wake of the outbreak, we placed a high priority on the safety of cash use by the public, and also took measures in this respect. First, supply of new banknotes have been ensured. Prior to January 17 this year, the PBC had allocated nearly RMB600 billion of new banknotes across the country, and immediately sent additional RMB4 billion yuan to Wuhan before the Spring Festival. The move improved the sense of security of bank branch staff and customers of cash 3688110/3688175/3974303/index.html 5/10 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production services. Secondly, we have made scientific and reasonable arrangements and allocation. We have suspended intra-provincial cash transportation in some severely affected areas and inter-provincial cash transportation. Personnel movements were minimized to reduce the risk of infection and transmission in travelling. Third, we have ensured that the cash withdrawal and distribution are hygienic and controllable. Commercial banks were required to divide their cash operations into inward direction and outward direction. The cash distributed outward should mainly use new banknotes. The cash withdrawn from hospitals and agricultural markets should be treated specially and sealed separately. After disinfection, it shall be deposited at the PBC and not be paid outward. Moreover, we released the Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Security of Cash Use During the Period of Epidemic Prevention and Control, which required the PBC branches and commercial banks to follow the mentality of categorized management and adopt differentiated control measures according to local epidemic situation to ensure safe cash use. The cash withdrawn from key areas of epidemic control should only re-enter the market after disinfection with ultraviolet or high temperature and storage for more than 14 days. The cash from other areas, should be stored for more than 7 days after disinfection before re-entering the market. The current measures have proved effective. We aim to ensure the safety and hygiene of cash for peoples use. Next, we will speed up promoting the work in mobile payments. At present, the businesses in this field are developing so rapidly that the compound annual growth rates of the number and value of mobile payments have reached 83.5 percent and 39 percent respectively in the last three years. Chinas electronic payment is fairly advanced. Recently, there have been interesting news in many areas, such as vegetable baskets without meeting -people order and pay on their mobile phones, receiving fresh and affordable meat, eggs, vegetables and fruits without going out, which has resolved a major problem in peoples lives during the epidemic outbreak. More measures will be taken in encouraging online banking, mobile banking, and 3688110/3688175/3974303/index.html 6/10 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production other channels to provide customers with 24/7 services in financial investment, utilities payment, and online shopping. Cloud Quick Pass, UnionPays mobile payment app, provides various online payment services such as fund transfer, credit card repayment without service charges, mobile phone top-up, and utilities payment. It supports balance inquiry of 610 banks across the country and credit card bill inquiry of nearly 150 banks. We are all working on this progressively in an orderly way. Thank you. Journalist with Bloomberg: Deputy Governor Fan, the current epidemic will exert great strain on both the supply side and the demand side. Will this bring inflationary pressure? What measures will the PBC take to prevent inflation rate, CPI and PPI from surging? My second question is about non-performing loans (NPLs). Affected by the current epidemic, will NPLs of the banks soar in the entire economical domain? What measures should the relevant Chinese authorities take in this regard? Will they make efforts to prevent large-scale unemployment and bankruptcy? Fan Yifei: As for inflation, since the restart of enterprises operation and production takes time, both the demand side and other aspects have brought certain pressure on price stability. However, the premise to maintain a sound monetary policy has remained unchanged. In response to these problems, we will make adjustments in time. I believe China will definitely not experience large-scale inflation. You are also concerned about NPLs. Just now, Vice Chairman Liang Tao mentioned that there may be adjustments for commercial banks NPLs to allow increases to some extent. We have been prepared in this regard. I believe that with our efforts, the NPL problem can be properly resolved. 3688110/3688175/3974303/index.html 7/10 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production In these two years, we have been strengthening the governance against financial risks, including NPLs. Generally speaking, NPLs only account for a relatively low proportion. Compared with other countries, we still have much room for adjustment. I believe we can cope with this problem well. 3688110/3688175/3974303/index.html 8/10 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production Date of last update FEB. 19, 2020 3688110/3688175/3974303/index.html 9/10 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Fan Yifei Attends the Press Conference on the Financial Systems Full Support for Fighting against Coronavirus Epidemic and Restarting Production 3688110/3688175/3974303/index.html 10/10

Title: Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development
text: 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends the Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends the Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development To Read Chinese Version The State Council Information Office held a press conference at 10 a.m. on February 24, 2020 (Monday). Officials from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Commerce and the Peoples Bank of China (PBC) were invited to introduce the progress in coordinating efforts to prevent and control the COVID-19 outbreak and promote economic and social development. PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu attended the conference and took press questions. The transcript of Deputy Governor Chens responses to the questions is as follows. Journalist with Lianhe Zaobao of Singapore: Will China introduce strong stimulus monetary or fiscal policies to relieve the economic impact of the epidemic? Thank you. 3688110/3688175/3980001/index.html 1/9 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends the Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development Chen Yulu: Thank you for your question. Monetary and financial policies are important policy measures to respond to the impact of emergencies and restore economic growth. Ever since the COVID-19 outbreak, the PBC has followed the decisions and arrangements made by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and the State Council, acted upon the principle that a sound monetary policy should be pursued in a flexible and appropriate manner, strengthened countercyclical adjustments and rolled out a series of monetary policy measures. First, the PBC provided more-than-expected liquidity to keep the liquidity in the banking system and money market adequate and stabilize market sentiment in time. Second, RMB300 billion of low-cost special central bank lending was set up in the first place, so as to provide favorable funding support for enterprises playing a key role in combating the epidemic in a precise manner. Third, five authorities including the PBC jointly introduced 30 measures to support epidemic control, in a bid to forge policy synergies and provide comprehensive financial guarantee for epidemic control and production resumption. So far, the measures have all produced positive results. In the next step, the PBC will resolutely implement the instructions in the important speeches of General Secretary Xi Jinping, practicing the sound monetary policy in a more flexible and appropriate manner. We will mainly strength measures in three aspects. First, the PBC will continue keeping liquidity reasonable and adequate, guide the overall market rates to move down further through policy rates and thus lower financing costs for enterprises. Second, the PBC will more vigorously leverage structural monetary policy tools. One is to proceed properly with the RMB300 billion worth of special central bank lending, and rapidly issue loans to eligible applicants. Currently, nearly 1,000 enterprises have been granted with special central bank lending, and next we will continue implementing the policy in a targeted fashion. The other is to make the best use of and enhance policy strength of the existing inclusive monetary policy tools, such as central bank lending in support of agriculture, 3688110/3688175/3980001/index.html 2/9 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends the Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development rural area and farmers and micro and small enterprises (MSEs) as well as central bank discounts. The PBC is scheduled to make an annual dynamic adjustment to targeted RRR cuts for inclusive finance, after which more qualified banks will be able to enjoy preferential policies. Third, we should work to further give full play to the role of policy finance. Previously, the three policy banks, namely China Development Bank, the Export-Import Bank of China and the Agricultural Development Bank of China, voluntarily took financial measures to support epidemic control, which have all worked well. In the next step, the PBC will further facilitate the three banks efforts to expand financing support for manufacturing enterprises, foreign trade enterprises and enterprises in the whole industrial chain of hog production, respectively. We are formulating measures for these endeavors and will unveil them as soon as possible. For the time being, China has ample monetary policy space and tools, so we have the confidence and ability to win the comprehensive battle against the epidemic, facilitate work and production resumption in the national economy and restore economic growth soon. Thank you. Journalist with Bloomberg News: Deputy Governor Chen, you mentioned that a more tolerant NPL rate will be adopted for MSEs. How tolerant could it be? Thank you. Chen Yulu: Addressing difficulties in and high costs of financing for MSEs and private enterprises is an important part in the supply-side structural reform of the financial sector, as well as a long-time priority for the PBC. Since the outbreak of the epidemic, the most affected have been traditional services and the labor-intensive manufacturing sectors, in which most players are micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). Therefore, the financial sector must pledge full support to help MSMEs tide through the difficult times, as this has an important bearing on the big picture of epidemic control, work and production resumption, employment stability and restoration of economic growth. Among the 30 measures released by five 3688110/3688175/3980001/index.html 3/9 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends the Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development authorities including the PBC on February 1, many are aimed at supporting MSMEs. Financial institutions are required to increase credit to these enterprises and refrain from blindly withdrawing, cutting or delaying loans issued to them. Meanwhile, financial institutions can extend or renew loans issued to enterprises which have trouble in making repayment. As far as I can tell, most enterprises on the recipient list of the RMB300 billion special central bank lending are MSMEs. In the next step, we will provide financial support for MSMEs by focusing on the following aspects: First, we will support commercial banks to secure sufficient sources of funds for loans issued to MSMEs. In addition to increased efforts to employ monetary policy tools like targeted RRR reduction for financial inclusion, central bank lending for supporting agriculture and MSEs, and central bank discount, we will encourage commerical banks to issue more special financial bonds for MSMEs, so as to enable commercial banks to have sufficient sources of concessional funds. Second, we will support the three policy banks to increase credit support for MSMEs in the manufacturing sector, foreign trade sector and the industry chain of hog production as well as those preparing for spring ploughing. Third, for sectors and MSMEs which are heavily affected by the epidemic and thus default on loans for a period of time, it is allowed not to include such defaults in their credit records, and preferential support in terms of loan risk classification will be considered. Fourth, we will guide commercial banks to make good use of Fintech in which China already has first-mover advantages, so as to comprehensively improve our capacity for risk identification and management and minimize the increase in nonperforming loans (NPLs). But it should be noted that in 2019, the average NPL ratio of commercial banks in China was only 3688110/3688175/3980001/index.html 4/9 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends the Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development 1.86 percent, and the NPL ratio of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), though slightly higher than the commercial banks average, was still far below the regulatory threshold of 5 percent. In addition, the provision coverage ratio of Chinas commercial banks was as high as over 180 percent, so we have ample resources and capabilities to cope with the impact of the epidemic on SMEs and the national economy. Thank you. Journalist with China Daily: Weve learned that the COVID-19 outbreak has had a considerable impact on Chinas economy. How will it influence the opening-up of the financial sector? Thank you. Chen Yulu: The opening-up has been a fundamental national policy, and inclusiveness is a cultural tradition of the Chinese nation. Since 2018, the financial system has resolutely implemented the guiding principles of General Secretary Xi Jinpings address at the Boao Forum for Asia, and introduced more than 40 vigorous and influential measures to further open up the financial sector. At present, most of these measures have been put in place, with a few of them awaiting amendments to relevant laws and regulations to be exercised in time. Ever since the epidemic, while fully supporting epidemic control and orderly resumption of work and production, the financial system has been continuing to push ahead with financial opening-up measures. On February 11, the PBC and the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission approved the Mastercard NUCCs application for bankcard clearing institution preparations, which is a good example in this regard. On February 14, the PBC worked together with relevant authorities to introduce the Opinions on Further Accelerating the Development of Shanghai as an International Financial Center and Providing Financial Support for the Integrated Development of the Yangtze River Delta. Among the 30 measures newly laid out 3688110/3688175/3980001/index.html 5/9 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends the Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development in the Opinions, 11 are devised to further promote high-level financial opening-up in the development of Shanghai as an international financial center. The international community has commented favorably on Chinas measures to further open up the financial sector amid its intense efforts to contain the epidemic. The year 2020 will be critical to financial opening-up, as the removal of foreign ownership limits on securities, fund management and futures companies are brought forward to 2020 from 2021. Therefore, we are geared up to assist relevant authorities with revising relevant laws and regulations, in a bid to ensure that all these measures can be implemented as scheduled. After the total of more than 40 measures are put in place, they will lay a solid foundation for Chinas commitment to implement across the board the management system of pre-establishment national treatment and negative list. Of course, while opening up the financial sector, we are also constantly improving the capacity for risk prevention, enhancing macroprudential management, advancing the establishment of a modern financial regulatory framework, and building a risk prevention system adapted to a higher-level of openness. Thank you. 3688110/3688175/3980001/index.html 6/9 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends the Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development 3688110/3688175/3980001/index.html 7/9 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends the Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development Date of last update FEB. 28, 2020 3688110/3688175/3980001/index.html 8/9 26/10/2021, 10:42 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends the Press Conference on Coordinating Epidemic Control and Economic and Social Development 3688110/3688175/3980001/index.html 9/9

Title: Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses
text: 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses To Read Chinese Version The State Council Information Office held a press conference at 2 p.m. on February 27, 2020 (Thursday). Officials from Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Peoples Bank of China (PBC), the State Administration for Market Regulation and the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission were invited to introduce the progress in supporting the development of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) and stepping up support for self-employed businesses. PBC Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang attended the conference and answered questions from the press. The transcript of Deputy Governor Lius speech and responses to press questions is as follows. Liu Guoqiang: Faced with the severe challenges posed by the COVID-19 outbreak, the PBC has followed the guidance of Xi Jinpings Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, resolutely implemented the decisions and arrangements made by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and the State Council regarding 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 1/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses coordinating epidemic control and economic and social development, responded with early and swift actions, pledged full support for endeavors to the battle against the epidemic and promote sound economic and social development. We have taken a series of targeted and strong measures. First, targeted tools have been used to guarantee precise supply. The PBC launched RMB300 billion worth of special central bank lending for financial institutions to issue loans at favorable rates to key enterprises engaged in epidemic control, so as to support the enterprises that participate directly in the battle against the epidemic. With interest subsidies, the average real interest rate of issued loans was 1.28 percent, lower than the required level of no more than 1.6 percent stipulated by the State Council. Second, work has been done to maintain the liquidity reasonable and adequate. On March 3 and 4, the PBC injected a total of RMB1.7 trillion through reverse repos, which played a key role in maintaining market liquidity and financial market stability in the first several days following the market opening. Upon the maturity of the funds, these short-term liquidity has been withdrawnwhile liquidity in the market remained reasonable and adequate. Third, the overall interest rates have been guided to move down. The interest rates of reverse repos and mediumterm lending facility (MLF) were lowered by 10 basis points one after another, and the one-year and five-year loan prime rates (LPR) fell by 10 and 5 basis points respectively on February 20, which drove down the overall market rates. Fourth, the PBC has taken the initiative to interpret policies. By making its voices heard at appropriate times through press releases, special interviews and signed articles, the PBC has worked to interpret the monetary policy stance and the measures in support of epidemic control, actively communicated with the market and the press, and elaborated on policy goals in a fact-based manner to increase transparency. The measures above have ensured reasonable and adequate liquidity in the banking system and stable operation of the financial market during the special period of epidemic control. With the money market rates moving down, the 7-day repo 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 2/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses rate has been around 2.2 percent. The stock market has recovered from the declines following the Spring Festival holiday, and the exchange rate of RMB against the US dollar has fluctuated around 7 in both directions. The policy measures China has taken in response to the epidemic have been well received by the financial market and all aspects of the society, and highly appreciated by the International Monetary Fund (IMF), the World Bank, and the international financial community. It is widely recognized that the impact of COVID-19 outbreak will be temporary and limited, Chinas economy will continue to demonstrate its strong resilience, and there is ample policy space for the Chinese government to stabilize economic growth. Recently, in line with the requirements laid out at the 83rd State Council Executive Meeting, the PBC promptly worked to strengthen credit support for resumption of work and production by MSMEs. As a dynamic force driving economic development and creating job opportunities, MSMEs are of key importance to work and production resumption, as well as the realization of this years goals of economic and social development. At present, MSMEs are facing difficuties with labor recruiting, production restarting and industry chain supporting as well as considerable funding strains. Therefore, with appropriate preferential support for MSMEs, we can stimulate the vitality of entities in the real economy, thus helping to promote high-quality economic development, advance the sustainable development of the financial sector and smooth the virtuous economic and financial circle. First, we will keep the liquidity reasonable and adequate. A combination of policy tools, such as MLF, open market operations and standing lending facility (SLF) will be utilized to satisfy the liquidity demand of financial institutions in supporting the work and production resumption of enterprises, to lower financing costs for the real economy, and to promote stable operation of the financial market. Measures will be taken to ensure that the growth of money and credit as well as aggregate financing to the real economy (AFRE) are well-aligned with economic development, to maintain the stability of macro leverage 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 3/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses ratio and prices, to properly cope with the impact of the epidemic and the short-term downward pressures on the economy, and to strike a balance between steady growth and risk prevention. Second, we will leverage structural monetary policy tools to enhance support for work and production resumption of MSMEs in accordance with the market-oriented and law-based principles. We will manage the special central bank lending based on a list of enterprises and exercised strict limits on the use of funds, so as to ensure that low-cost funds can be promptly and precisely provided to key enterprises securing supplies at the crucial stage of the battle against the epidemic. Recently, we increased central bank lending and central bank discount quotas by a total of RMB500 billion, which was an inclusive measure to support eligible enterprises in a market-oriented manner. In order to effectively stimulate and mobilize funds, the interest rates of central bank lending in support of agriculture and micro and small enterprises (MSEs) were lowered from 2.75 percent to 2.5 percent, a drop of 0.25 percentage points. Third, the synergy of the financial system will be leveraged through overall coordination to differentiate various types of banks and encourage them to issue loans at preferential rates. Banks operating nationwide have sufficient sources of funds and therefore a relatively low cost of funds. As the recent decline in the market rates effectively reduced the cost of issuing bonds and interbank certificates of deposit, and considering that the assessment of targeted cuts in the required reserve ratio (RRR) for financial inclusion will release more funds in the next step, these nationwide banks are expected to play a leading role. Policy banks have a positive role in making countercyclical adjustment and bolstering areas of weakness, and thus should support MSMEs in resuming work and production by increasing total credit supply, offering special lines of credit, and granting loans at preferential rates. Locally incorporated banks are the main force in serving the local economy and 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 4/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses supporting MSMEs. The PBC will provide them with low-cost funds so as to help them tackle problems such as limited sources of funds and high costs of capital, and guide them to increase inclusive loans for MSEs work and production resumption. In the next step, the sound monetary policy should be more focused on its flexibility and appropriateness, and a greater importance will be attached to supporting the real economy to resume its development. By stabilizing expectations, expanding aggregates, adopting differentiatied approaches, emphasizing loan extensions, innovating instruments and ensuring implementation, the PBC will provide strong monetary policy support for fighting the epidemic and advancing the real economy, minimize the economic impact of the epidemic and strive to realize this years economic and social development goals. Journalist with China National Radio, China Media Group: Recently, the entire nation has been engaged in the battle against the COVID-19 outbreak. As the Deputy Governor of the central bank, would you please introduce the monetary and credit support provided by the PBC for the epidemic control? And whats your comment on the monetary policy stance in the next phrase? Thank you. Liu Guoqiang: Thanks for your question. These concerns are very important. In view of the performance of the economy and market during the special period of epidemic control, the PBC has responded with early and swift actions, pledged full support for epidemic control and taken targeted measures to support enterprises in resuming work and production. The major measures are as follows: First, we have increased reverse repos in open market operations. The interest rates on reverse repos and the MLF, and the LPR fell by 10 basis points successively, which brought down market interest rates and played a key role in maintaining market 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 5/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses liquidity and financial market stability in the first days following the market opening after the Spring Festival. At present, this short-term liquidity has been basically withdrawn upon the maturity of the funds, while liquidity in the market remains reasonable and adequate. Second, we have set up RMB300 billion of low-cost special central bank lending. The funds are offered to major nationwide banks, and locally incorporated banks in ten key provinces and municipalities, including Hubei Province, so as to enable targeted support for enterprises directly joining the battle against the epidemic. Specifically, the RMB300 billion funds are allocated to nine nationwide banks and the local banks in ten key regions, so that they can finance the production and transport of anti-virus materials, including masks, protective suits, disinfectants, and other clothing or equipment used by doctors and nurses. That is to say, we lend the money to the banks, and banks lend it to enterprises, which are under listbased management. These two measures, one in quantitative and the other in structural terms, are adopted in a targeted manner. They have effectively stabilized market sentiment and are expected to help claim the victory against the epidemic. By February 25, a total of 1,008 key enterprises producing supplies have obtained loans. With interest subsidies, the average real interest rate of these loans was 1.28 percent, lower than the required level of no more than 1.6 percent stipulated by the State Council. In addition, the 7-day interbank repo rate has been kept at around 2.2 percent, indicating stable performance; and the stock and exchange markets are generally steady with some flexbilities. All parties have commented favorably on the policy measures we have taken in response to the epidemic. In the next step, the sound monetary policy should be practiced in a further more flexible and appropriate manner, and greater importance will be attached to supporting the real economy to resume its development. By stabilizing expectations, expanding aggregates, adopting differentiated approaches, emphasizing loan extensions, innovating instruments and 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 6/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses ensuring implementation, the PBC will provide strong monetary policy support for fighting the epidemic and advancing the real economy, so as to minimize the economic impact of the epidemic and strive to realize this years economic and social development goals. First, the PBC will make good use of existing support policies, ensuring that special central bank lending will continue to fund in favor of small and medium-sized banks. We will apply a mix of monetary policy tools, such as open market operations, MLF and SLF, and conduct the dynamic assessment of last years targeted RRR cuts for financial inclusion at an appropriate point to release long-term liquidity. Since some banks have already met the standards regarding inclusive financial services, we will lower their RRR to support them in providing better inclusive service. In addition, we will also push ahead with the LPR reform to promote an overall decrease in both market interest rates and loan rates. Second, new policy measures will be introduced as needed to support enterprises resuming work and production. We will increase central bank lending and central bank discount quotas, and offer guidance to banks according to their different types so that loans will be issued to MSMEs at preferential rates to support the resumption of work and production. We will also guide financial institutions to enhance credit support for MSEs, encourage banks to replenish capital through multiple channels, and explore innovative tools for the replenishment of bank capital. As large amounts of cheap funds have been provided to small and medium-sized banks, their liquidity strains have been eased and liquidity costs reduced considerably. However, capital adequacy is another constraint on bank lending. Therefore, what we will do next is to step up policy support for capital replenishment by small and medium-sized banks in line with their lending needs, so as to improve their overall capacity of credit supply and further advance the development of the real economy. Thank you. Journalist with Reuters: I have two questions. First, regarding small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and self- employed businesses that have not fully resumed production, how are they getting on? Are there any statistics 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 7/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses available? Second, do small and medium-sized local banks still have the capacity and strength to support local SMEs? Thank you. Liu Guoqiang: Id like to add some observations about small and medium-sized banks. The first is about the incentives for them to extend loans to enterprises at a rate of 4.55 percent, i.e., the LPR plus 50 basis points. We believe they should feel motivated, since the funding cost is relatively low. The PBC provides central bank lending to small and medium-sized banks at a rate of 2.5 percent, and they then issue loans at 4.55 percent, which leaves a moderate spread of over 200 basis points. Also, we will conduct assessments to urge for the implementation of the measure, while considering how to provide policy support in this regard. As I mentioned just now, this will include capital replenishment for small and medium-sized banks, as well as other fiscal and financial measures. This is an important issue, but it seems quite difficult to give a clear-cut answer at the moment. Following the State Council Executive Meeting which had been held the day before yesterday, we made work arrangements yesterday afternoon, and relevant work has just kicked off. Our plan is well designed, but we have to closely follow how well it works and then further improve the policy. We hope the media can follow up as well and raise questions and suggestions. This is what Id like to say about the incentives for small and medium-sized banks. The other question concerns the adequacy of the lending quotas. Currently there are two types of central bank lending. One is the RMB300 billion special central bank lending dedicated to supporting the producers of epidemic prevention goods. While enterprises on the list are increasing and more loans are being extended to them every day, the quota has not been used up yet and need not be adjusted so far. We will continue to use the RMB300 billion quota properly. The other type is the RMB500 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 8/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses billion quota for central bank lending and central bank discount, which was put in place only yesterday. How it will work out remains to be seen. In case of inadequacy in the future, we will consider increasing the quota. But there is another possibility. With the resumption of work and production, the cycle will go back to normal so that enterprises will have more and more funds of their own, leaving some of the quota unused. We will closely follow the developments and improve the policy continuously. Thank you. Journalist with Market News International: My question is, while increasing credit supply to MSMEs, what will you do to prevent their credit risks and reduce the risk premium for banks? Liu Guoqiang: I fully agree with you. This is a market-based process, in which banks and enterprises are free to select each other. Its not that banks have to lend to an enterprise who is not an eligible borrower. Here I want to add a point from the macro perspective. The real economy is the foundation of the financial sector. Currently, many enterprises are faced with temporary difficulties, and banks support can help them out. Otherwise, things may get worse for them, and it is even likely that they will go bankrupt. Most non-performing assets of banks are the result of business failures. Loans go bad once borrowers go bankrupt. Therefore, from the macro perspective, providing support to improve the cycle between the economy and the financial sector will help reduce non-performing assets in the banking sector. Thank you. Journalist with CNBC: I have two questions. First, the US Federal Reserve and other major foreign financial organizations have shown concerns about the epidemics impacts on the economy and the growing number of cases overseas. What are the PBCs latest considerations on the domestic monetary policy? Will it adopt further rate cuts or 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 9/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses other measures? Second, with regard to stabilizing employment, some companies are applying for employment support. Whats the opinion of PBC on stabilizing wages and what measures will be taken specifically? Thanks. Liu Guoqiang: Thank you. I share the same concerns with international institutions about the negative impacts of the epidemic on global economy, while the worry has materialized. Now, the epidemic has its impacts across the globe. It not only has an influence on Chinas economy, but with its occurrence overseas, the economy of other countries is also affected. For example, trade, industry chains and financial markets have all suffered to a certain degree. However, it is broadly believed that the impacts will only last for a short period, with no changes to either the fundamentals or the long-term trend. To overcome such impacts in China, General Secretary Xi Jinping has stressed that China should focus on performing its own duties. As the worlds second largest economy, Chinas economic growth is a key driving force for the global economy, and the sound development of China provides strong supports to the global economic stability. How to realize healthy development? Undoubtedly, there are many aspects to be focused on, among which I will take the perspective of monetary policy. We should unswervingly adhere to the stance of sound monetary policy. Currently, by contrast to many countries adopting unconventional monetary policy including zero interest rates, China remains one of the few countries with normal monetary policy. There is still a long way for us from such unconventional policies. Therefore, the policy space is relatively large, and we are capable to deal with all kinds of challenges in the future. This condition should be valued and maintained. At the same time, based on the current economic situation, it is also necessary to keep the monetary policy flexible and appropriate, and manage countercyclical adjustments in a scientific and sound manner. Just now, I mentioned some measures, such as RMB300 billion of special central bank lending and RMB500 billion of central bank lending and discounts. 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 10/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses These instruments are structural tools with influence on the aggregates as well. However, their structural features remained prominent. Regarding the aggregates, we have managed to keep the liquidity at reasonably adequate level through SLF, MLF, open market operations and targeted RRR reductions for financial inclusion. Another dimension is the cost of funds. In terms of interest rates, the lending rates in China have been basically market-oriented. Since the adoption of LPR, the interest rates have been trending downward apparently. Not only does the LPR itself fall, but also it brings down rates of the entire financial markets, including credit rates. So far, there is still some room for further decline. Therefore, in the next step, we will continue to reform the rates by improving relevant systems and mechanisms, aiming to fully tap the downward potential of market rates. Meanwhile, the policy transmission mechanism should be further improved. The LPR reform has been progressing smoothly in the previous phase, when newly issued loans are basically priced based on the LPR instead of the original benchmark lending rate. You might have noticed recently that for both the RMB300 billion and the RMB500 billion policy tools introduced, banks are required to price loans to enterprises in reference to the LPR rather than the benchmark lending rate. This is a market-oriented approach, reflecting a shift of pricing benchmark for newly issued loans. In addition, the outstanding loans should also adopt LPR, which was scheduled to start from March 1. We expect no change to the time frame. Based on thorough investigation and study, we believe that pushing ahead with the plan is beneficial to liberalizing interest rates and bringing the interest rates down. During the outbreak, we should try to handle businesses online through mobile and online banking. For businesses which are difficult to process online and require on-site services in bank outlets, we will guide commercial banks to provide services based on appointments or use automatic machines. Commercial banks are also coming up with their own methods. 3688110/3688175/3984060/index.html 11/13 26/10/2021, 10:50 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends the Press Conference on Supporting Development of MSMEs and Stepping Up Support for Self-Employed Businesses Therefore, the transition time frame remains unchanged. Despite differences in progress among banks, I believe it will be generally accomplished on schedule. Thank you.
