Title: State Council Policy Briefing on Handling of NPC Deputies Suggestions and CPPCC National Committee Members Proposals by State Council Agencies in 2019
text: 26/10/2021, 10:47 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Handling of NPC Deputies Suggestions and CPPCC National Committee Members Proposals by State Council Agencies i Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Handling of NPC Deputies Suggestions and CPPCC National Committee Members Proposals by State Council Agencies in 2019 To Read Chinese Version The State Council Information Office held a regular press briefing at 10 a.m. on May 9, 2020 (Saturday). Li Meng, Vice Minister of Science and Technology, Li Jinzao, Vice Minister of Culture and Tourism, Li Bin, Vice Minister of the National Health Commission, Chen Yulu, Deputy Governor of the Peoples Bank of China (PBC) and Xi Yanchun, spokesperson of the State Council Information Office introduced the handling of the suggestions of deputies to the National Peoples Congress (NPC) and the proposals of members of the Chinese Peoples Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) National Committee by the State Council agencies in 2019, and answered questions from the press. Selected transcript is as follows. (This English version only covers the speech and answers of PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu.) Chen Yulu: Dear friends from the media, good morning! The PBC Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) has attached great importance to earnestly handling the suggestions and proposals of NPC deputies and CPPCC National Committee members. The task is enlisted in the PBCs work agenda each year, and constitutes a significant part in fulfilling its 3688110/3688175/4021625/index.html 1/7 26/10/2021, 10:47 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Handling of NPC Deputies Suggestions and CPPCC National Committee Members Proposals by State Council Agencies i mandates in line with laws. In 2019, the PBC handled 28 NPC deputies proposals, 412 NPC deputies suggestions and 242 CPPCC National Committee members proposals, which added up to a total of 682 items. Specifically, 788 NPC deputies, 263 CPPCC National Committee members and eight democratic parties and institutions proposed a lot of targeted and constructive comments and suggestions with respect to providing financial support for the real economy, promoting the opening-up and development of key regions, facilitating poverty alleviation and rural revitalization, forestalling and defusing financial risks in key areas, improving financial services and management, etc. Their contribution is of great significance for the endeavors to improve and enhance the financial work. The PBC thoroughly implemented the important arrangements made by the State Council on facilitating the NPC and the CPPCC. With commitment to high and strict standards, the PBC handled the suggestions and proposals on schedule and realised 100 percent in both settlement rate and communication rate with deputies and members. In terms of the actual effects of its handling, many suggestions proposed by NPC deputies and CPPCC National Committee members have been translated into specific policies and measures of the PBC. In 2019, the PBC rolled out 38 concrete policies and measures based on conscientious study and adoption of the suggestions and proposals of the deputies and members, thus vigorously propelling the smooth development of major tasks such as strengthening financial support for micro, small and mediumsized enterprises (MSMEs), winning the battle against poverty, forestalling and defusing financial risks in key areas, openingup and developing the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and other key regions, and promoting green finance reform and innovation. Handling the suggestions of NPC deputies and the proposals of CPPCC National Committee members is a highly legitimate policy-oriented task with significant effects. It is a key demonstration of the PBCs people-centered philosophy and 3688110/3688175/4021625/index.html 2/7 26/10/2021, 10:47 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Handling of NPC Deputies Suggestions and CPPCC National Committee Members Proposals by State Council Agencies i conscientious fulfillment of its duties, as well as an important intellectual support for performing duties in a scientific manner. This year, the PBC will earnestly implement the guiding principles of the State Council Executive Meeting held on April 28. The handling of suggestions and proposals will be combined with the fulfillment of duties with greater sense of responsibility and mission. In a bid to satisfy the deputies and members and reassure the people, the PBC will intensively study the suggestions and proposals of the deputies and members, handle each of them in a fact-based manner, and strive to transform their insights to policies and measures for promoting pandemic containment and economic and social development in a coordinated manner. Thank you. Journalist with Hong Kong Economic Herald: Weve learned that, the suggestions regarding how to resolve the financing difficulties and lower the financing costs for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) were defined by the General Office of the NPC Standing Committee as key suggestions to be handled under its supervision in 2019, and were assigned to the PBC which would lead the work. Could you please introduce the handling of such suggestions and the results? Thank you. Chen Yulu: Thank you for your attention. Addressing difficulties in and high costs of financing for micro, small and mediumsized enterprises (MSMEs) has always been a key focus of the NPC deputies and CPPCC National Committee members, as well as a long-term and challenging task of the PBC. In 2019, over 80 of the suggestions and proposals handled by the PBC involved the issue, and that figure doesnt even include key ones supervised by the NPC themed in this regard. In response, the PBC made special work plans and schemes, conducted field research in cities like Ningbo, Taizhou, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Hefei and Changsha, and communicated face-to-face with the deputies and members concerned. 3688110/3688175/4021625/index.html 3/7 26/10/2021, 10:47 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Handling of NPC Deputies Suggestions and CPPCC National Committee Members Proposals by State Council Agencies i In recent years, the PBC fully considered the recommendations in the suggestions and proposals when introducing policies. For example, with respect to addressing financing difficulties, the PBC lowered required reserve ratio (RRR) three times last year, releasing RMB2.7 trillion of long-term liquidity in total. Meanwhile, it managed to improve the capacity of small and medium-sized banks to serve MSMEs by using tools like central bank lending and central bank discount. In addition, the PBC encouraged financial institutions to issue bonds and credit asset-backed securities for micro and small businesses (MSBs). Last year, special bonds issued by financial institutions for MSBs reached RMB204.8 billion cumulatively, roughly RMB80 billion more than that in 2018. In addressing the high costs of financing, the PBC adopted policy-oriented low interest rates for both central bank lending and discount, and reformed the loan prime rate formation mechanism, or the well-known LPR formation mechanism, in a market-oriented manner, which guided a downward trend in market rates. A recent PBC survey shows that it is widely recognized that the difficulties faced by enterprises in accessing affordable financing have been eased. Since the beginning of this year, in light of the impact of COVID-19, the PBC resolutely has implemented the decisions and arrangements made by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council by comprehensively enhancing support for MSMEs, including the release of liquidity through tools such as RMB300 billion worth of special central bank lending, RMB500 billion worth of central bank lending and central bank discount quota and RMB550 billion worth of targeted RRR cuts for inclusive finance, as well as temporary arrangements for MSMEs delayed repayment of principal and interest. These measures have yielded significant results in guiding financial institutions to increase MSME loan supply, lower loan rates and reduce MSMEs burden. By end-March, the outstanding inclusive MSB loans amounted to RMB12.4 trillion, a year-on-year increase of 23.6 percent, up 4.5 percentage points from a year earlier. 3688110/3688175/4021625/index.html 4/7 26/10/2021, 10:47 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Handling of NPC Deputies Suggestions and CPPCC National Committee Members Proposals by State Council Agencies i When formulating relevant policies in the future, we will continue to solicit comments and suggestions from the deputies and members, and further improve financial support for MSMEs. Thank you. Journalist with China Review News: We know that winning the battle of targeted poverty alleviation and promoting rural revitalization are missions that must be accomplished for the building of a moderately prosperous society in all aspects, which have also aroused widespread concerns among the deputies and members. What has the PBC done in particular with respect to financial support? Thank you. Chen Yulu: Thank you for your question. As is widely known, Chinas poverty reduction is a great battle that attracts worldwide attention, and financial inclusion is a key mission for the modern financial system with Chinese characteristics. In 2019, earnestly implementing the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee on winning the tough battle against poverty, the PBC integrated financial support for poverty alleviation with the building of inclusive financial system, and combined financial support with the tough battle of risk prevention. With a new policy mix in place, the precision, effectiveness and sustainability of financial support for poverty alleviation have been improved. Efforts were mainly made in three aspects: First, directional guidance for credit policies was strengthened to facilitate financial institutions of various types to deepen reform and hence improve their capabilities of providing financial support for targeted poverty alleviation and promoting rural revitalization. Second, the policy of targeted RRR cuts for financial inclusion was properly implemented. The PBC set up special central bank lending for poverty alleviation in impoverished areas, so as to guide financial institutions to effectively allocate more credit 3688110/3688175/4021625/index.html 5/7 26/10/2021, 10:47 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Handling of NPC Deputies Suggestions and CPPCC National Committee Members Proposals by State Council Agencies i resources to these areas. Third, more financial resources were allocated in favor of severely impoverished areas. The PBC organized and guided financial institutions to allocate more resources to these areas by means of effective fund allocating and staffing. In 2019, it spared no effort in pushing forward full coverage of basic and inclusive services in severely impoverished areas in three regions and three prefectures. So far, basic financial services have been available in all administrative villages. The comments and suggestions from the deputies and members have contributed significantly to the formulation of these policy measures. Nearly 50 suggestions and proposals handled by the PBC focused on this topic, among which many issues and recommendations are highly valuable, such as those put forward by deputy Zhou Shaojun from Guizhou province, deputy Yang Weikun from Hebei province and committee member Niu Ximing from the Bank of Communications. Following intensive studies, we directly translated them into policy measures on financial support for targeted poverty alleviation, which have been fruitful. The year of 2020 is crucial to winning the tough battle against poverty. With the impact from the pandemic, the task that lies ahead in providing financial support for poverty alleviation is extremely arduous. Since the outbreak of COVID-19, the PBC has intensified its efforts in providing financial support for target poverty alleviation, introducing a series of measures such as extending the repayment period for microfinance for poverty alleviation and greatly increasing the quota for special central bank lending in severely impoverished areas, and proactively coordinated COVID-19 containment and financial support for targeted poverty alleviation, in a bid to ensure that the general goal of winning the tough battle against poverty is achieved as scheduled. Thank you. 3688110/3688175/4021625/index.html 6/7 26/10/2021, 10:47 Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Handling of NPC Deputies Suggestions and CPPCC National Committee Members Proposals by State Council Agencies i Date of last update MAY 11, 2020 3688110/3688175/4021625/index.html 7/7

Title: Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development
text: 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development To Read Chinese Version The article titled Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development by Governor Yi Gang of the Peoples Bank of China was published in the Qiushi Journal (Issue 10, 2020). The full text is as follows. As the lifeblood of the economy, finance provides fundamental services that are indispensable to social life. The COVID-19 outbreak, coupled with an economic downturn, has had a significant impact on Chinas economic and financial operations. In the face of the pandemic, the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has made a series of decisions and arrangements to coordinate pandemic containment efforts with economic and social development. In line with the important instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping and the requirements of the Central Leading Group for COVID-19 Response, the Joint Prevention and Control Mechanism of the State Council, as well as the State Council Financial Stability and Development Committee (FSDC), the Peoples Bank of China (PBC) has remained committed to a people-centered approach and the fundamental task of serving the real economy. It has performed the duties of the FSDC 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 1/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development Office conscientiously and led the financial sector in firmly implementing the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council in an effort to provide strong support for winning the battle against the pandemic and promoting economic and social development. I. Creating a Favorable Monetary and Financial Environment for Pandemic Containment and the Stable Operation of Financial Markets Of the major public health emergencies the People's Republic of China has witnessed since its founding, the COVID-19 pandemic is the fastest spreading, the most widely infectious, and the hardest to contain, which has not only impacted Chinas economy and finance but has also put them to the test. Confronted with an extraordinarily severe and complex situation, the PBC has acted quickly in accordance with the requirement of the CPC Central Committee that the sound monetary policy should be conducted in a more flexible and appropriate manner. A number of measures have been taken to strengthen countercyclical adjustment in monetary policy, keep liquidity in the financial system adequate at a reasonable level, and stabilize market expectations, with firm support pledged for the reopening of financial markets as scheduled on February 3, 2020, so as to convey a signal of strong confidence in winning the battle against the pandemic. First, in terms of aggregates, liquidity was injected in more-than-expected amounts. After the required reserve ratio (RRR) was cut by 0.5 percentage points for financial institutions on January 6, 2020, which released over RMB800 billion in long-term funding, the PBC conducted reverse repos worth a total of RMB1.7 trillion on February 3 when financial markets resumed trading and on February 4. In addition, targeted RRR cuts were carried out in March and April, freeing up RMB550 billion and RMB400 billion of long-term liquidity, respectively. Meanwhile, a mix of monetary policy tools, such as the standing lending 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 2/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development facility (SLF), central bank lending, and central bank discount, were employed to ensure that liquidity in financial markets is adequate at a reasonable level. Second, in terms of prices, work was done in an orderly manner to guide interest rates in the money and credit markets to move downward. Since the beginning of this year, in open market operations, the interest rates of reverse repos and the medium-term lending facility (MLF) have both declined by 30 basis points, and the 1-year loan prime rate (LPR) has also fallen by 30 basis points. At end-April, the 10-year government bond yield stood at 2.5 percent, down 0.9 percentage points from the highest level in 2019; the 1-year government bond yield was only around 1.1 percent, representing a record low. Currently, solid progress has been made in the countercyclical adjustments through monetary policies that were adopted earlier. First, money, credit and the aggregate financing to the real economy (AFRE) maintained fast growth at a reasonable level and corporate financing costs declined. In the first four months of 2020, RMB loans increased by RMB8.8 trillion, an acceleration of RMB1.97 trillion over the same period last year. The AFRE posted a growth of RMB14.19 trillion, an acceleration of RMB3.91 trillion over the same period last year. At end-April, broad money supply (M2) rose by 11.1 percent year on year, up 2.6 percentage points from a year earlier. Amid the combined effects of the Spring Festival and the COVID-19 headwinds on economic growth, these figures reflected strengthened countercyclical adjustments. From February to April 2020, as a result of the special low-cost central bank lending, fiscal interest subsidies and the reductions in LPR, the corporate lending rates witnessed a significant fall. Especially in Q1, the average rate of inclusive loans newly issued to micro and small businesses (MSBs) by the five major banks stood at 4.4 percent, down 0.3 percentage points from the annual average in 2019. Second, financial markets reopened as scheduled, and both the stock and foreign exchange markets weathered the test. The stock market first fell and then rebounded after its reopening on February 3, which greatly boosted market confidence. Since late 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 3/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development February, as the worlds major stock indices fluctuated significantly and the panics spread, Chinas A-share market also fell somewhat. Nevertheless, the A-share market performed generally in a sound manner, and its fluctuations were much smaller compared with those in other major economies. The exchange rate of the RMB against the US dollar featured two-way fluctuations. From early 2020 to May 10, the accumulative depreciation of the RMB was below 2 percent and market expectations remained stable. Additionally, the money market, the bond market, the commercial paper market, the gold market, and other financial markets all reopened as scheduled and generally operated stably. Faced with a severe and complex situation, the PBC stood up to market pressure and ensured the reopening of financial markets as scheduled, which reflected not only the CPC Central Committees resolution to maintain market rules but also the maturing of Chinas financial markets. This has won not only the full recognition of market participants but also applause from the International Monetary Fund and other institutions. II. Providing special and efficient financial services to meet the emergent needs of pandemic containment efforts As part of the national efforts fighting COVID-19, the PBC has acted promptly to open up green channels for all kinds of financial services, to ensure uninterrupted basic financial services, and to pledge full support for the production of medical supplies and daily necessities. On February 1, the PBC, the Ministry of Finance (MOF), the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (CBIRC), the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) jointly released the Notice on Further Strengthening Financial Support for Containing the COVID-19 Outbreak and introduced 30 financial measures in five aspects, thus providing credit support at preferential interest rates for 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 4/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development enterprises to secure supplies for the fight against the pandemic and rolling out differentiated preferential financial policies for regions, industries, enterprises and households that were heavily hit by the pandemic. Providing credit support for manufacturers of important medical supplies and daily necessities at preferential interest rates in an attempt to meet the financial needs of the enterprises that secure supplies for the fight against COVID-19. Fiscal, financial and industrial policies have been implemented in a coordinated manner. The PBC has set up RMB300 billion of low-cost special central bank lending, and adopted list-based management for key enterprises engaging in COVID-19 containment jointly with the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT). The fiscal authorities granted interest subsidies while the audit authorities supervised the whole process to ensure that the special central bank lending funds were used for the listed enterprises that most needed them in combating the pandemic. Meanwhile, commercial banks proactively inquired about the needs of the listed enterprises and sped up loan issuance to eligible applicants under the principle of quick loan issuance to all qualified entities at a lending rate of the latest 1-year LPR minus 100 basis points. As of May 9, nine banks operating nationwide and 10 provincial- and municipal-level locally incorporated banks had issued a total of RMB272.7 billion loans to 7,151 key enterprises at preferential rates, with a weighted average interest rate of 2.5 percent. Given a 50 percent interest subsidy granted by the fiscal authorities, the real lending cost was only around 1.25 percent, far lower than the average lending rate for enterprises of around 5 percent. This has effectively met the financing needs of enterprises which secure supplies for the fight against the pandemic. Setting up a green channel for uninterrupted fund transfers that are necessary to combat COVID-19. 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 5/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development In order to meet the needs of large-value fund transfers of the payments for emergency supplies for COVID-19 containment as well as for donated materials and funds from all walks of life at home and abroad, the PBC has opened up a green channel during public holidays. From January 24 to May 10, the High-Value Payment System (HVPS) and the Bulk Electronic Payment System (BEPS) processed a total of 8,153 special transactions of payments above RMB10 million for COVID-19 containment in Hubei Province with an aggregate value of RMB549.4 billion. And the number of bank accounts opened through the green channel for entities engaging in pandemic control amounted to 14,632. The PBC has also launched an responsive plan for COVID-19 containment in time to ensure the continuous and stable operation of the micropayment business of commercial banks as well as mobile payment businesses such as WeChat Pay and Alipay. Additionally, the PBC guided clearing institutions, commercial banks and non-banking payment institutions to reduce or exempt charges of transactions, and 15 national commercial banks waived handling fees for all donations to the fight against the pandemic. Processing emergency fund appropriation from the State Treasury to ensure timely fund provision for pandemic containment. Appropriating treasury funds is a statutory duty of the PBC as the State Treasury manager. In the special times of COVID-19 containment, the PBCs State Treasury System has worked to further enhance the efficiency of appropriating government funds to race against the clock to fight the pandemic. As of May 10, the treasury department had processed a total of 141,042 transfers of fund appropriation for COVID-19 containment for fiscal authorities at all levels, the total value of which amounted to RMB114.8 billion. Specifically, 2,200 transfers worth of RMB44.77 billion were special subsidies granted by the central and provincial fiscal authorities to support local governments in COVID-19 containment, which strongly secured the fund provision 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 6/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development for all parties involved in the process, including local health commissions, designated hospitals, community health service centers, and hospital construction units. Establishing the green channel for foreign exchange businesses to facilitate trade in goods and supplies for combating COVID-19. In the wake of the pandemic, the trade in goods and supplies for medical care and treatment, quarantine, disinfection, sterilization and other pandemic prevention needs surged, which posed urgent demand for greater convenience of foreign exchange services. In response, the PBC has directed the SAFE to streamline procedures for foreign exchange sales and purchases for the imports of goods and supplies necessary to combat COVID-19, and organized banks to open up green channels for relevant businesses. The formalities for crediting international donations and selling foreign exchange were simplified, and banks were allowed to process foreign exchange credit and sales directly. For COVID-19 containment-related payments initiated by enterprises using the money obtained from foreign exchange sales under their capital accounts, banks could conduct ex-post reviews on the authenticity of the usage of funds, and the enterprises would be exempted from ex-ante submission of business documents to the banks on a case-by-case basis. For enterprises in need of more external debts for COVID-19 containment, the quotas have been lifted and the financing channels have thus been expanded. Delivering sound credit reporting services during the pandemic to earnestly protect relevant rights and interests of the public. Regarding the four types of people, namely those who had been hospitalized or quarantined for COVID-19, those who had been put under quarantine and medical observation out of containment needs, those who had participated in the COVID-19 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 7/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development containment work, and those who had temporarily lost sources of income as a result of the pandemic, the PBC required financial institutions to provide these people with preferential credit support as appropriate by, for example, flexibly adjusting the repayment arrangements for personal mortgages, credit card bills, etc., and properly postponing the repayment deadline. Additionally, in times of the pandemic, the overdue personal mortgages and credit card overdrafts may not be deemed as default and the individuals concerned may not be listed as default clients; and enterprises that have had difficulties in repaying their debts, which results in an overdue, shall not be officially recorded into their credit reports with defaults cases. Supporting enterprises to expand bond financing and reduce its costs. In order to mitigate the impact of COVID-19 on enterprise bond financing, the PBC has established the green channel for bond issuance, including extending the term of validity of bond quotas, reasonably adjusting the time limit on information disclosure, and promptly adjusting relevant policies to facilitate online services. For corporate credit bonds aimed mainly at raising funds for COVID-19 control and issued by enterprises in hard-hit regions, the service charges have been reduced. Furthermore, the membership fees of corporate issuers in Hubei Province have been halved for the first three months of 2020. As of end-April 2020, a total of 388 special bonds for pandemic control had been issued with a total value of RMB399.3 billion. III. Proactively Coping with COVID-19 Impact and Fully Implementing the Task of ensuring security in the six areas The PBC has worked to resolutely implement the decisions and arrangements made by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, and carried out all-round financial supports for coordinating and supporting pandemic containment as well as economic and social development according to the changes in COVID-19 containment and economic and financial situations. In particular, the PBC has intensified its efforts in ensuring stability on the six fronts (employment, financial sector, foreign 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 8/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development trade, foreign investment, domestic investment and expectations) by earnestly implementing the task of ensuring security in the six areas (the employment of residents, the basic livelihood of the people, the support for market entities, the security of food and energy, the stability of the supply chain and industrial chain, and the operation at grassroots level). With ensuring security in the six areas serving as the focus of ensuring stability on the six fronts, great importance has been attached to the work on ensuring the stability of enterprises and the security of employment with financial support. Stepping up financial support for MSMEs work and production resumption in line with the market-oriented and lawbased principles. At present, there are approximately 20 million incorporated MSBs in China, accounting for over 90 percent of all incorporated market entities. And there are more than 80 million self-employed businesses. How to effectively address the financing problems of MSMEs in their efforts to resume work and production is not only an important economic and financial issue, but also a key concern with respect to employment and peoples livelihood. On February 25, based on the study by the State Council Executive Meeting, the PBC unveiled policy measures to offer financial support for MSMEs work and production resumption, striving to achieve the general goal of increasing volume, lowering price, raising quality and expanding coverage for MSB financing in 2020. First, the PBC set up RMB1.8 trillion worth of central bank lending and central bank discounts. Specifically, RMB300 billion worth of special central bank lending was launched to support pandemic containment and guarantee supply, and another RMB500 billion quotas of central bank lending and central bank discounts were released for locally incorporated banks to grant loans at preferential rates to enterprises in support of their work and production resumption. In addition, RMB1 trillion 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 9/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development of the central bank lending and central bank discount quota was added for small and medium-sized banks, so that they can provide loans at preferential rates for a larger number and a wider range of MSMEs, and this lending scheme is expected to cover over 2 million enterprises. The PBC lowered the interest rates on central bank lending for agriculture and MSBs from 2.75 percent to 2.5 percent, and required that commercial banks issue loans at a rate of no more than 4.55 percent if the funds used are from the PBC. As of May 7, financial institutions had issued a total of RMB705.2 billion of loans at preferential rates. Second, policy banks were encouraged to increase RMB350 billion special credit quotas for private enterprises and MSBs, which will be gradually put in place by the end of June. The annual credit program of policy banks was raised by RMB600 billion. Following the principle of breaking even and securing small margins, the three policy banks are expected to significantly lower their actual lending rates. Third, financial institutions were guided to increase RMB300 billion low-interest loans targeting self-employed businesses heavily afflicted with the pandemic. The PBC urged large state-owned commercial banks to boost their credit supply to MSBs, in a dedicated bid to ensure that at end-H1, the year-on-year growth of outstanding inclusive MSB loans is no less than 30 percent and the loan rates move downward significantly compared with 2019. Fourth, the PBC ramped up support for bond financing. A green channel for bond issuance in this special period was set up. From January to April, the issuance of corporate credit bonds reached RMB4.6 trillion, an increase of 46 percent from a year earlier; bonds issued by private enterprises totaled around RMB270 billion, registering a new high in recent years. Meanwhile, 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 10/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development the PBC has been working to guide the growth of full-year net financing of corporate credit bonds to increase by RMB1 trillion over the previous year, and support financial institutions to issue RMB300 billion worth of MSB financial bonds across the year. Fifth, the PBC worked to advance the connection between core enterprises, large state-owned commercial banks and accounts receivable financing platforms. In Q1 2020, MSMEs raised a capital of RMB156.8 billion via the accounts receivable financing platforms. The PBCs annual goal is to encourage MSMEs to raise a total of RMB800 billion with accounts receivable. In addition, in collaboration with CBIRC and other authorities, the PBC encouraged financial institutions to arrange provisional deferment of loan repayments for qualified MSMEs (including self-employed businesses) which are faced with temporary liquidity difficulties, in light of their applications and in line with the market-oriented and law-based principles. For the principals of loans to mature on or after January 25, 2020, the date of repayment can be extended to as late as June 30, 2020; for interests to be paid between January 25 and June 30, 2020, the date of payment can be extended to as late as June 30, 2020 as well, and any penalty interest is waived. As of April 15, the banking institutions had granted approval for deferred repayments of over RMB1 trillion worth of loans. Specifically, the deferred payments of principals involved 604,000 borrowers and totaled RMB963.71 billion, and those of interests involved 519,000 borrowers and amounted to RMB48.15 billion. Making proactive and sound moves to address the pressing concerns of enterprises in work and production resumption, such as debt payment, capital turnover and financing expansion. The PBC has worked with relevant authorities to innovate and improve means of financial support, encourage financial institutions to establish separate credit lines for key regions of pandemic containment, and provide special credit quotas for 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 11/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development heavily-hit sectors and enterprises. The PBC has also urged financial institutions to strengthen support for enterprises loan extension and renewal, significantly streamline relevant procedures, reduce or remit interest charges as appropriate and moderately expand the scope of recipients of purely credit-based loans, so as to guard enterprises against the break in capital chains and other problems alike. Moreover, for sectors heavily impacted by the pandemic and enterprises with good prospects yet in temporary difficulties due to the pandemic, financial institutions were required not to blindly withdraw, cut or delay loans issued to them. Intensifying support to key sectors and weak links. In the long run, the key to coping with COVID-19s economic and financial impacts lies in the commitment to promoting high- quality economic development and continuously advancing transformation, upgrading and structural readjustment in accordance with the new development philosophy. Therefore, the PBC has dedicated great efforts to optimize the allocation of financial resources, and organized the banking institutions to increase financial support for the worst-hit regions and key enterprises, especially sectors severely affected by the pandemic such as tourism, entertainment, accommodation, catering and transportation, as well as key areas and weak links like poverty alleviation, peoples livelihood and employment, through regional financing policy adjustments, internal funds transfer pricing, etc. Various preferential policies have been implemented in a meticulous manner, so as to smooth financing channels, reduce financing costs and thoroughly improve the quality and efficiency of financial services. Meanwhile, the PBC has also organized the banking institutions to bolster credit support for advanced manufacturing, high-tech manufacturing and emerging industries, increase medium and long-term loan issuance to the manufacturing sector, and guide more superb resources into key areas driving high-quality economic development. 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 12/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development IV. Continuously Deepening Financial Reform and Expand Opening-up We should make good use of financial support policies and take both short-term and long-term interests into account. The PBC has continued with the supply-side structural reform of the financial sector in the sense that accelerated financial reform and further financial opening-up is achieved while continuously enhancing the capability of preventing and defusing financial risks. Deepening the market-based reform of interest rates. Interest rates are the most important financial factor price. The PBC eased the control over lending rates and deposit rates in July 2013 and October 2015 respectively, making major breakthroughs in the market-based reform of interest rates. Since the introduction of the loan prime rate (LPR) quoted by commercial banks in 2019, interest rates have been more market-based and on a continuous decline. More than 90 percent of newly-issued loans are using LPR as the pricing benchmark by now. After launching the transition of the pricing benchmark of outstanding floating-rate loans to the loan prime rate on March 1, 2020, the PBC has further smoothed monetary policy transmission, removed the implicit floor of lending rates, steered interest rates downwards and reduced the interest burden on enterprises and residents. In March 2020, the average interest rate on corporate loans recorded 4.82 percent, decreasing 0.5 percentage points from July 2019 prior to the LPR reform. Pushing forward financial reform and opening-up in key regions and aspects. On February 14, 2020, the PBC, CBIRC, CSRC, SAFE and Shanghai Municipal Government jointly released the Opinions on Further Accelerating the Development of Shanghai as an International Financial Center and Providing Financial Support for the 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 13/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development Integrated Development of the Yangtze River Delta Regionlaying out a total of 30 specific measures. The Opinions is aligned with the highest international standards in light of the requirement of high-quality development, so as to develop Shanghai into a spearhead in the financial reform and opening-up, as well as prepare for fully implementing the financial opening-up model featuring pre-establishment national treatment and negative list management. On May 7, the PBC specified the simplified administrative rules on funds of domestic securities and futures investment by foreign institutional investors, removing the limit on the domestic securities investment by Qualified Foreign Institutional Investors (QFIIs) and RMB Qualified Foreign Institutional Investors (RQFIIs) as well as limits such as the number of custodians, in a bid to further facilitate foreign investors participation in Chinas financial market. Continuously pressing ahead with the critical battle of preventing and defusing major financial risks. Preventing and defusing major risks is one of the Three Critical Battles defined at the 19th CPC National Congress, representing a major move to secure a decisive victory in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects. In 2020, the PBC continues to earnestly fulfill the responsibilities as the General Affairs Office of the FSDC, promoting resolution of financial risks in key areas in a prudent and orderly manner and further accelerating the development of the system of preventing and defusing financial risks. On March 5, the PBC, together with NDRC, the MOF, CBIRC, CSRC and SAFE, published the Work Plan for Coordinated Regulation of Financial Infrastructures, aiming to unify regulatory standards for financial infrastructures, enhance market access administration, and put in place an advanced, reliable and flexible financial infrastructure system featuring well-balanced layout and effective governance. Moreover, pilot commercial banks and a number of insurers have been encouraged to participate in the trading of government bond futures at the China Financial 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 14/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development Futures Exchange, so as to further satisfy the risk management needs of banks and insurers and diversify the investor base in the market. Further strengthening international financial cooperation. In order to create a favorable international environment, the PBC has, since the outbreak of the pandemic, been vocal in the international community, closely communicated with organizations like the IMF, and timely responded to international concerns. On March 2, the Belt and Road Interbank Regular Cooperation (BRBR) Mechanism released the Initiative on Supporting China and Other Countries in Combating the COVID-19, fully acknowledging Chinas decisive efforts and strong measures to control the pandemic. At the teleconferences of the IMFs International Monetary and Financial Committee on March 4 and April 16, the teleconferences of the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) on March 8 and May 5, as well as the virtual meeting of G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors on March 23, the PBC introduced to the worlds major countries and economies Chinas financial support for pandemic containment and orderly work and production resumption, as well as what we have done and achieved in stabilizing supply chains of China and beyond, which shored up the international communitys confidence in Chinas economic growth. At present, the battle of pandemic containment has achieved major strategic results, and the restoration of economic and social order is picking up pace. However, the spread of coronavirus outside China has exerted overwhelmingly adverse impacts on the worlds economic and financial conditions, which has also posed new challenges to Chinas economic development. With a vast size, strong resilience and large room for maneuver, the Chinese economy has many favorable conditions for maintaining stable economic and financial development. The PBC will follow the arrangements of the CPC 3688110/3688175/4027500/index.html 15/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Well Leveraging Financial Support Policies to Bolster Pandemic Containment and Economic and Social Development Central Committee, give full play to the driving role of such financial policies as central bank lending, central bank discount and loan forbearance, smooth policy transmission and provide strong support to keep businesses and employment stable and maintain development of the real economy. Meanwhile, steps will also be taken to strengthen countercyclical adjustments of monetary policy, attach greater importance to its flexibility and appropriateness, maintain the stability of the financial market, and strive to win the victories of both pandemic containment and economic and social development. Title: Interview by Financial News and China Finance on Key Issues During Two Sessions
Subtitle: Journalist: The COVID-19 pandemic has taken a heavy toll on the global and Chinese economy, as evidenced by the year-on-year 6.8 percent decline of Chinas GDP in Q1. What do you think of the current international and domestic economic situations?
text: 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by Financial News and China Finance on Key Issues During Two Sessions To Read Chinese Version Journalist: The COVID-19 pandemic has taken a heavy toll on the global and Chinese economy, as evidenced by the year-on-year 6.8 percent decline of Chinas GDP in Q1. What do you think of the current international and domestic economic situations? Yi Gang: The COVID-19 pandemic is the most severe global pandemic we have ever experienced since the World War II. It has now affected more than 200 countries and regions across the globe with over 5.4 million confirmed cases, and the spread has not stopped to date. The pandemic has dealt a heavy blow to the global economy, with interruption in the circulation of industry chains and supply chains, contraction in international trade and investment, and surge in unemployment. Notably, the Great Lockdown worldwide in response to the pandemic will show its remarkable impact on the global economy in Q2. According to the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and other international organizations, major advanced economies are projected to suffer an unprecedented hit in Q2, and the economic contraction will be probably much worse than that during 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 1/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions the 2008 global financial crisis or even the Great Depression in the last century. The global financial market has become less volatile following drastic fluctuations at earlier stages, but the fundamentals remain grim with risks lingering. In Q1 2020, the COVID-19 pandemic posed a severe impact on Chinas economic and social development. GDP witnessed a 6.8 percent decline year on year amid a double-digit fall in investment, consumption and exports. Meanwhile, some enterprises, particularly private enterprises, as well as micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) faced greater challenges in production and operation. Under the strong leadership of the CPC Central Committee with General Secretary Xi Jinping at its core, the country proceeded in confidence and unity, took scientific prevention and control measures and practiced targeted policies. So far, China has delivered significant strategic achievements in coordinating Covid-19 containment and economic and social development, as the order of production and life has been basically restored and economic statistics are taking an upward turn. The official purchasing managers index (PMI) for the manufacturing sector was recorded 50.8 in April, marking the second consecutive month for the index to stand above the threshold of 50. Despite great uncertainties surrounding the overseas pandemic situations and its impact, Chinas economy remains highly resilient with a huge domestic market, and the long-term sound economic fundamentals stay unchanged. Journalist: In response to the pandemic, central banks of major economies in Europe and the US have adopted unconventional quantitative easing policies. China has also taken a series of measures regarding financial macro regulation and monetary policy. How well do these measures work now? What are the basic stance and key considerations of monetary policy at the next stage? 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 2/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions Yi Gang: In order to offset the impact of the pandemic, the Peoples Bank of China (PBC), in concert with the Ministry of Finance (MOF) and China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (CBIRC), swiftly launched 30 financial support policy measures on February 1 to step up countercyclical adjustments to aggregates and employ structural monetary policy tools in an innovative way. Since the outbreak of Covid-19, the volume of offsetting policies implemented has reached RMB5.9 trillion, rendering strong support for Covid-19 containment and economic and social development. In terms of aggregates, we have injected liquidity in more-than-expected amounts via three rounds of cuts in required reserve ratio (RRR), strengthened open market operations and increased central bank lending and central bank discounts, to resolutely support the reopening of Chinas financial market on February 3 following the Spring Festival holiday as scheduled, and shore up the confidence of the financial market. In terms of prices, we have guided the decline in interest rates of reverse repos in open market operations and of mediumterm lending facility (MLF) as well as the loan prime rate (LPR). In the meantime, the transition of the pricing benchmark of outstanding floating-rate loans to LPR has been initiated to drive down the interest rates on outstanding loans. In terms of structure, we have introduced targeted polices according to the situation of the pandemic. Specifically, we have proactively leveraged RMB300 billion worth of special central bank lending at favorable rates, RMB1.5 trillion worth of inclusive central bank lending and central bank discounts and RMB600 billion of additional lending quotas for policy banks, to provide priority support for key manufacturers of medical and daily supplies for Covid-19 containment, as well as heavily-hit MSMEs and enterprises in the service sector. 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 3/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions In terms of policy coordination, we have enhanced the coordination between monetary policy and fiscal policy, industrial policy as well as financial regulatory policy, provided fiscal interest subsidies for manufacturers of important medical and daily supplies for Covid-19 containment, and extended the time limit for MSMEs to repay loan principal and interest in a bid to help them weather the difficult time. This mix of measures has produced remarkable results. Money and credit have expanded even though most economic indicators witnessed declines. From January to April, RMB loans surged by RMB8.8 trillion, nearly RMB2 trillion more than the increase in the same period last year. Broad money (M2) and the outstanding aggregate financing to the real economy (AFRE) mounted by 11.1 percent and 12 percent year on year respectively, much faster than those of last year, which reflected rigorous countercyclical adjustments. Since the beginning of this year, the financing of MSMEs has realized increase in scale, drop in price and expansion in coverage. At end-April, outstanding inclusive loans issued to micro and small businesses (MSBs) grew by 25.1 percent year on year, two percentage points higher than the growth rate at end-2019. In April, the average interest rate on new inclusive MSB loans stood at 5.24 percent, down 0.77 percentage points from that of last December. At end-April, the number of MSMEs with outstanding loans from financial institutions exceeded 28 million. At the next stage, we will pursue a sound monetary policy that is more flexible and appropriate, and, in line with the requirements laid out in the Report on the Work of the Government, comprehensively leverage and innovate a variety of monetary policy tools to ensure adequate liquidity at a reasonable level and maintain an accelerated growth of M2 and AFRE from last year. 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 4/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions Journalist: At present, the pandemic imposes heavier pressure on enterprises, especially MSMEs. As is stated in this years Report on the Work of the Government, the authorities should develop new monetary policy tools that can directly stimulate the real economy, increase financial support to keep business operations stable, and do their best to help enterprises, particularly MSMEs, and self-employed businesses get through this difficult time. What are the measures taken by the central bank to implement these requirements? Yi Gang: Since COVID-19 broke out, the PBC has earnestly implemented the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, developed innovative monetary policy tools and shortened the transmission chain of monetary policy by pursuing a differentiated and precise money and credit policy to directly stimulate the financing of enterprises. First of all, we have launched RMB300 billion special central bank lending for financial institutions to issue loans at favorable rates to key enterprises in the supply chain of medical and daily necessities for pandemic containment. In other words, to secure supplies. As of May 23, nearly RMB280 billion out of the RMB300 billion central bank lending had been used to support banks to issue preferential loans to over 7,000 key enterprises, with an estimated actual financing rate of 1.25 percent after deducting fiscal interest. The special central bank lending followed the rule that special cases should be handled with special approaches and with haste, and played an essential role in the fight against the pandemic and in ensuring sufficient supplies. Prior to issuance there is a set of strict procedures. The issuance process is bound by a record system. Following the issuance there awaits review by audit authorities. Any illicit issuance of loans will be investigated once identified, thus ensuring that the special central bank lending fulfils its special purposes. 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 5/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions Second, we have increased the quota dedicated to central bank lending and central bank discounts by RMB1.5 trillion to step up financial support for the orderly resumption of work and production, poverty alleviation, spring farming and tillage preparation, and poultry and livestock breeding. We have also provided inclusive financing support for MSBs in heavily-hit sectors like tourism and entertainment, accommodation and catering, and transportation. Up to May 21, a total of RMB472 billion of loans (including discounts) out of the quota for special central bank lending and central bank discounts had been granted by financial institutions to 570,000 enterprises (including rural households) at favorable rates. The policy design of the special quota is a market-oriented financial inclusion mechanism. It is a sustainable policy for both banks and enterprises, given that it not only reduces the financing costs for enterprises but also helps small and medium-sized banks balance their budgets. Third, we have adopted the policy of provisional deferment of loan principal and interest repayments for MSMEs to strengthen support for enterprises, particularly for MSMEs. By April 30, financial institutions had granted approval for deferred repayments of over RMB1.2 trillion MSME loans. Next, the PBC will work hard to meet the requirements of the Report on the Work of the Government by becoming more innovative in terms of monetary policies and rendering financial support in a more targeted and precise manner: First, the PBC is going to extend the policy of provisional deferment of loan principal and interest repayments for MSMEs. Specifically, MSMEs will be allowed to repay loan principals which are set to mature by end-2020 and accrued interests of loans remaining outstanding by end-2020 as late as March 31, 2021. In the meantime, financial institutions will be required to make their best efforts to defer repayments of inclusive MSB loans. 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 6/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions Second, the PBC will ramp up credit support for MSBs. A plan of inclusive MSB credit support will be in place, and new monetary policy tools will be created to support eligible locally incorporated banking financial institutions to issue new inclusive MSB credit loans, so as to encourage banking financial institutions to lift the proportion of credit loans. Third, the PBC will improve the government-backed guarantee mechanism. We will raise the multiplier of policy financing guarantors, expand the scale of financing guarantees, focus less on the requirements for profit assessment, and lower guarantee rates and counter guarantee requirements. Moreover, local governments will be encouraged to develop cash pooling of risk compensation to support MSBs for emergency on-lending and government-backed financing guarantors for capital replenishment. Fourth, the PBC will reinforce support for financing in the bond market. We will guide the growth of full-year net financing of corporate credit bonds to increase by RMB1 trillion over the previous year, so as to release more credit resources to support MSBs. At the same time, we will support financial institutions to issue RMB300 billion worth of special financial bonds to MSBs in 2020, which will be exclusively spent as MSB loans. Fifth, the PBC will work hard to develop supply chain finance. Credit support for the resumption of work and production of key enterprises, leading enterprises and their associated enterprises will be boosted to propel the recovery of industry chains. We will also accelerate the implementation of regulations on timely payments and strengthen key enterprises repayments of accounts payable. We are also going to capitalize on the platform for accounts receivable financing services to help MSMEs raise RMB800 billion via this form of financing in 2020. In addition, efforts will be made to urge key enterprises to confirm the 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 7/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions authenticity and integrity of accounts receivable in a bid to encourage the use of commercial bills with well-defined rights and responsibilities in accounts receivable. Journalist: This year marks the end of the Three Critical Battles. What achievements has the PBC made in forestalling and defusing major financial risks after more than two years of hard work? Will the COVID-19 pandemic add to the risks challenging Chinas financial system, particularly those faced by small and medium-sized banks? Are there any precautionary measures? Yi Gang: Since 2018, in accordance with the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, and the requirements of the Financial Stability and Development Committee (FSDC), the financial sector has captured positive progress in forestalling and defusing financial risks with a range of proactive and effective measures. Specifically, we have secured preliminary progress in curbing the excessively rapid growth of the macro leverage ratio, effectively contained the chaotic development of shadow banking, and advanced the steady and orderly disposal of key high-risk financial groups. Financial risks involving the public like those of Internet finance and illegal fundraising have been brought under full control, and system refinement of forestalling and defusing financial risks is well underway, enabling effective response to financial market fluctuations and risks concerning external shocks. In general, prominent risks in key fields are treated in an orderly manner, the upward momentum of systemic risks is effectively contained, and the financial sector is developing steadily and healthily as a whole. Nevertheless, the COVID-19 pandemic has taken an unprecedented toll on Chinas economic and social development and exerted certain downward pressure on the quality of banks credit assets. Specifically, the risks of some small and medium- 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 8/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions sized financial institutions attract our attention. In Q1 2020, commercial banks in China registered a net profit of RMB600 billion, which was mainly attributed to the increased assets and a lowered management cost-to-income ratio in the banking sector. Due to the lag of nonperforming loan (NPL) risk exposure and the deferment of enterprises principal and interest repayment of bank loans, banks may face considerable pressure caused by a rising NPL ratio, growing nonperforming assets and increased difficulties in the disposal of bad assets later on. Meanwhile, if the pandemic is prolonged globally, the world economy will bear increasingly heavy losses and the turmoil in the overseas financial markets may spread further, which will deal a blow to the Chinese market and bring about uncertainties to our balance of payments and cross-border capital flow. Going forward, based on a full assessment of difficulties, risks and uncertainties, we will stick to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability. We will continue to follow the fundamental guidelines and policies established by the central government, properly handle the relationship between pandemic containment, economic recovery and risk control, strengthen countercyclical adjustments of macro policies, and prudently advance risk disposal tasks. We will also support banks, especially small and medium-sized ones, to replenish capital through multiple channels, improve governance and enhance disposal of NPLs, so as to bolster the soundness of financial institutions. In forestalling and defusing financial risks, the PBC will earnestly fulfill the functions and responsibilities as the Office of the FSDC under the State Council by enhancing the coordination of financial regulation, properly handling the relationship between holding the bottom line of preventing systemic financial risks and guarding against moral hazards, and putting greater emphasis on ensuring that financial institutions assume major responsibilities, local governments fulfill 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 9/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions responsibilities within their jurisdictions, financial regulators undertake regulatory responsibilities and act as the lender of last resort. Once any major financial risk occurs, relevant shareholders and creditors shall bear the consequential losses according to the law, and stringent measures shall be taken to hold relevant institutions and personnel accountable for illegal conducts and negligence and dereliction of duties. Journalist: This years Report on the Work of the Government noted that we should advance reforms to promote marketbased allocation of factors. How will the PBC further promote market-based reform of interest rates? Yi Gang: Interest rates are the most important financial factor prices. As one of the foremost reforms in the financial sector, the market-based reform of interest rates aims to improve the mechanism where prices are mainly determined by the market, and to prudently promote the integration of benchmark deposit and lending rates with market interest rates. The PBC eased the control over lending rates and deposit rates in July 2013 and October 2015 respectively. Since the PBC launched a reform in August 2019 to improve the LPR formation mechanism, noteworthy progress has been made in the market-based reform of interest rates: First, the correlation between then LPR and the supply and demand of market funding has been significantly enhanced. For example, the one-year and above-five-year LPRs released in May 2020 stood at 3.85 percent and 4.65 percent respectively, down 0.4 percentage points and 0.2 percentage points respectively from August 2019 when the reform started. This fully reflects changes in the supply and demand of market funding. Second, the transmission efficiency of monetary policy has been substantially increased. In mid-May 2020, loans issued at rates that were less than 0.9 times the original benchmark lending rate accounted for 35.3 percent of all new loans, nearly four 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 10/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions times the volume prior to the LPR reform. The implicit floor of lending rates has been removed. Third, effective moves have been made to lower lending rates in real terms. In April this year, the average interest rate on corporate loans recorded 4.81 percent, decreasing 0.51 percentage points from July 2019 prior to the LPR reform. The decline is projected to continue into May. Fourth, the LPR reform has also been an important catalyst for the market-based reform of deposit rates. As the interest rates in loan markets go down, banks make less profit from loan issuance. As a result, in order to match with the yields of assets, they will reduce the cost of liabilities as appropriate, thus impairing the motivation to solicit deposits with high interest rates. In fact, certain changes have taken place in banks deposit rates, as some banks have voluntarily lowered deposit rates, and the rates on deposit-like products such as money market funds which practice market-based pricing have fallen as well. In the next step, the PBC will continue to deepen the LPR reform, smooth the transmission from interest rates in the money market to lending rates, and drive down real lending rates, so as to support the development of the real economy. Meanwhile, the transition of the pricing benchmark of outstanding loans will be advanced in an orderly manner. Journalist: Faced with changes in the external environment, the financial sector has been resolutely promoting opening-up at a higher level and liberalizing and facilitating trade and investment in recent years. What progress has been made in the implementation of the opening-up measures? Will the COVID-19 pandemic adversely influence the pace of China opening-up endeavors? What new measures will be rolled out to facilitate financial opening-up this year? 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 11/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions Yi Gang: In recent years, the financial sector has rolled out over 40 measures to advance voluntary opening-up both domestically and internationally. At present, solid progress has been made in the implementation of these measures, with most of them put in place at both legislative and practical levels. First, the foreign ownership caps in fields like banking, securities, fund management, futures and life insurance have been completely lifted, and the qualification requirements for foreign shareholders have been constantly relaxed. Second, national treatment has been granted to foreign-funded institutions in fields such as enterprise credit reporting, credit rating and payment businesses. The inter-connectivity of capital markets has been continuously deepened, and accounting, taxation and trading and other supporting systems have been continuously improved. Third, the pandemic has not disrupted Chinas pace to open up the financial market. Recently, MasterCards application for accessing Chinas bank card clearing market has been approved. Fitch Ratings has become the second international credit rating agency to enter the Chinese market following S&P Global. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley have been approved to take control of their securities joint ventures in China. Furthermore, the entry of foreign-funded financial institutions like BlackRock and Neuberger Berman into the Chinese market is also advancing in an orderly manner. These opening-up measures are designed to foster an open and inclusive financial environment which allows full competition, encourages innovations to the greatest extent and facilitates the financial sector in serving the real economy. While opening up wider, the financial sector has also constantly improved macroprudential management, strengthened efforts to prevent risks and worked hard to ensure financial regulatory capabilities and intensity stay adaptive to and in sync with financial opening-up. 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 12/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions In the next step, the PBC will continue acting upon the principle of market-oriented, law-based and internationalized development to actively and prudently promote the voluntary opening-up of the financial sector both domestically and internationally, and focus our efforts on the following aspects: First, the PBC will continue to effectively implement financial opening-up measures introduced in recent years and ensure that all of them are conscientiously carried out, so as to draw more foreign-funded and private financial institutions to the Chinese market. Second, the PBC will push for the thorough implementation of the pre-establishment national treatment and negative list system to promote systematic and institutionalized opening-up with consistent entry criteria. Third, the PBC will continue improving the business environment, streamline administration and delegate power, respect contracts, protect property rights, enhance the communication mechanism for policy making, and replace more ex-ante review and approval procedures with interim and ex-post supervision. Economic entities under all forms of ownership will be treated on an equal footing, and the fundamental role of the competition system will be strengthened. Fourth, the PBC will closely coordinate efforts to widen opening-up and to enhance regulation so as to effectively forestall and defuse financial risks. Journalist: The PBC started the research on central bank digital currency early on, and has launched internal and closed pilot testing in some cities. What is the significance of issuing central bank digital currency? What are the updates on the testing? And when is it expected to be issued officially? 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 13/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions Yi Gang: At present, digital economy has become an increasingly important driving force for global economic growth. The research on and the application of the central bank digital currency can help efficiently satisfy the publics demand for fiat money in the context of digital economy, and improve the convenience, security and anti-counterfeiting features of retail payments, thereby speeding up the development of Chinas digital economy. The PBC has started the study into central bank digital currency at an earlier time. In 2014, a specialized team was formed to probe into the digital currency issuance framework, key technologies, issuance and circulation environment as well as international practices in this regard. At end-2017, the PBC was approved to organize some well-established commercial banks as well as relevant institutions to work on the R&D of the digital RMB system, namely Digital Currency Electronic Payment (DC/EP). Based on the premises of two-layer operation, cash (M0) substitution and controllable anonymity, the PBC has basically completed the top-level design, formulation of standards, R&D of functions and joint debugging tests. Currently, we are advancing the R&D of DC/EP in line with the principles of steadiness, security, controllability, innovation and practicability. Internal and closed pilot tests are conducted in Shenzhen, Suzhou, Xiongan, Chengdu and some scenarios of the coming Winter Olympics to verify the reliability of theories, stability of systems, usability of functions, convenience of processes, applicability to scenarios and controllability of risks. However, these pilot tests are just part of our routine work in the R&D process, and should not be interpreted as an official issuance of DC/EP. There is no timetable for the official issuance yet. Journalist: This year will be a year of decisive victory for completing the building of a moderately prosperous society in all respects. What progress has the PBC made in delivering financial support for poverty alleviation? What measures 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 14/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions will the PBC adopt to optimize financial services for agriculture, rural areas and famers while putting risks under control, so as to better facilitate rural revitalization? Yi Gang: In recent years, the PBC has adhered to the approaches of coordinating financial support for poverty alleviation with financial inclusion and integrating financial support with risk prevention. As a result, the policies, organizations, products and service system with respect to financial support for targeted poverty alleviation have been constantly improved, and solid results have been achieved on all fronts. In 2020, China will conclude the battle against poverty, and complete the goal of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects. Following the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, the PBC will lay equal emphasis on financial support and risk prevention, win the battle against extreme poverty, lift all the remaining impoverished population and counties out of poverty, ensure high-quality poverty alleviation and explore the establishment of a long-term mechanism for eradication of relative poverty. In the next step, the PBC will make continued efforts by focusing on the following aspects. First, we will ensure a solid implementation of the policies on financial support for poverty alleviation, strengthen the application of monetary policy tools like central bank lending for poverty alleviation, provide stronger support for destitute areas like the three regions and three prefectures, and make financial services more inclusive and accessible in these areas. Second, the PBC will intensify financial support for efforts to eradicate poverty through industrial growth, help poverty-stricken areas to cultivate and develop businesses facilitating poverty alleviation, promote the integrated development of financial support and poverty alleviation through industrial growth, and expand financial support for industrial development following poverty alleviation 3688110/3688175/4031198/index.html 15/17 26/10/2021, 10:41 Interview with PBC Governor Yi Gang by iFinancial News/i and iChina Finance/i on Key Issues During Two Sessions through relocation. Third, steps will be taken to promote sustainable development of poverty alleviation through financial support, enhance quality monitoring of credit assets in impoverished areas, especially micro credit for poverty alleviation, enable prompt early warnings and prevent people from returning back to poverty because of the loans. Fourth, the PBC will advance the development of inclusive finance, accelerate the construction of infrastructure for payment, credit reporting and other basic services in impoverished areas, enhance the publicity of financial knowledge and the protection of the rights and interests of financial consumers, as well as consolidate and improve basic financial services in these areas. Fifth, the PBC will effectively align financial support for poverty alleviation with the strategy of rural revitalization, improve the capabilities of county-level incorporated financial institutions to serve rural areas and impoverished areas, summarize and publicize the achievements of targeted poverty alleviation through financial support, carry out research on follow-up policies in 2020, and establish a long-term mechanism to address relative poverty.
