With Chinese bonds added to the Bloomberg Barclays Global Aggregate Index and J.P. Morgans flagship indices, more funds have been attracted to the market. There are many institutional investors and large inflows of funds. Third, entry restrictions in such fields as corporate credit reporting, credit rating and payment and clearing have been lifted so that foreign investors can receive national treatment. A Chinese joint venture of American Express has gained approval to conduct bankcard clearing operations in China, and the wholly-owned units established by S&P Global and Fitch Ratings in China have been allowed to conduct credit rating business. Meanwhile, RMB internationalization has been making headway. In H1 2020, cross-border RMB receipts and payments increased by 36.7 percent year on year to RMB12.7 trillion, which accounted for 45 percent of the total of crossborder receipts and payments in the RMB and foreign currencies, making the RMB the second most used currency for crossborder payment in China for the eighth consecutive year. According to a release by the International Monetary Fund in Q1, holdings in the RMB took up 2 percent of total foreign exchange reserves, a share nearly doubling that recorded when the RMB was included in the Special Drawing Right (SDR) currency basket in 2016. Additionally, the use of the RMB as a denomination currency has made new progress. In May, China Baowu Steel Group completed its first RMB-denominated cross-border settlement in trading with the worlds top three iron ore suppliers. 3688110/3688175/4087230/index.html 10/18 26/10/2021, 10:44 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Implementation of Policies for Promoting Support Extended by Financial Institutions to Real Economy As shown by history and practice, openness brings progress whereas seclusion leads to backwardness. With financial opening- up constituting an important part of Chinas opening-up to the outside world, continued efforts will be made to further high- level opening-up of the financial sector with active and orderly steps and in line with internationalized, market-oriented and law-based principles. By active and orderly, I mean financial opening-up is a rational choice made by China based on its needs and interests, and our opening-up will not be carried out to please or displease others. Whether Chinas financial sector opens up or not will not be dictated by outside pressure. Going forward, first, work will be done to ensure the implementation of all the opening-up measures already announced and to improve policies and rules accordingly and facilitate orderly linkup. Second, efforts will be made to fully implement the management scheme of pre-establishment national treatment plus a negative list, achieve institutional and systemic opening-up, continuously improve the business environment, and foster a market environment in which domestic and foreign-funded enterprises are treated as equals and compete on a level playing field. Third, while expanding the opening-up of the financial sector, we will attach more importance to risk prevention and control by strengthening macroprudential management and improving the system of risk prevention and control. Regulations and arrangements, such as regulatory standards and accounting rules, will be improved based on national circumstances and international best practice so that our regulatory capacity will match the progress of opening-up. Fourth, we will safeguard and improve the current system of international economic governance, participate in international economic governance more actively, and work for the formation of a participating mechanism for international coordination of macroeconomic policies. Thank you. Journalist with Economic Daily: It was proposed at the State Council executive meeting that we will deepen the LPR reform and guide the lending rates to move downward further. As the LPR reform has been implemented for a year, what outcomes 3688110/3688175/4087230/index.html 11/18 26/10/2021, 10:44 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Implementation of Policies for Promoting Support Extended by Financial Institutions to Real Economy have been achieved so far? How is its effect on guiding lending rates downwards? What is the future plan for the reform? Thank you. Liu Guoqiang: Last August, the PBC, in line with the arrangements of the State Council, reformed and improved the LPR formation mechanism. The work has produced remarkable results owing to sustained effort for a year. First, the LPR has become more market-oriented. The LPR reform allowed panel banks to make their quotations by adding a few basis points to the MLF interest rate in accordance with the actual lending rates for their prime clients. The MLF interest rate is the medium-term policy rate of the central bank, and the LPR is formed by adding a few basis points to the interest rate, which underscored the increasing market-orientation of LPR. The LPR quotations have decreased gradually since August 2019. The one-year and above-five-year LPR, released this August, stood at 3.85 percent and 4.65 percent respectively, down 0.4 percentage points and 0.2 percentage points cumulatively since the reform. Second, the LPR has become a principal reference for loan pricing for financial institutions. They used to apply the benchmark rates as the reference for loan pricing, while the LPR has replaced the benchmark rates. At end-December 2019, over 90 percent of new loans were priced based on LPR. Since January 1, 2020, financial institutions have ceased to use the benchmark loan interest rates for pricing in contracts of floating-rate loans, and the LPR has been adopted instead for almost all new loans. Having basically completed the transition of the pricing benchmark of newly issued loans, we started shifting the pricing benchmark of outstanding floating-rate loans in March 2020 as scheduled. It has been steadily advanced in a market-oriented and law-based manner, and is expected to be completed by the end of this month. 3688110/3688175/4087230/index.html 12/18 26/10/2021, 10:44 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Implementation of Policies for Promoting Support Extended by Financial Institutions to Real Economy Third, the transmission efficiency of monetary policy has been improved significantly, with the integration of market and benchmark lending rates. From the perspective of banking institutions, the implicit floor of lending rates has been completely removed. Before the LPR reform, the loan interest rates were determined based on benchmark interest rates, with the one- year benchmark lending rate at 4.35 percent then. Commercial banks followed an implicit rule, which provided enterprises with the minimum lending rate of 90 percent of the benchmark, which was 3.915 percent as the lowest. Since the lending rates lower than this were unacceptable, a price floor was thus formed, which limited further decline in lending rates. The floor has been completely removed now, and its effects unfolded. In July 2020, the loan interest rates were lower than 0.9 times of the benchmark. That is to say, up to 40.2 percent of loans were issued at a lending rate lower than the floor price, 3.4 times more than or 4.4 times the figure before the reform was launched in July 2019. The internal pricing mechanism in banks has been further improved. The funds transfer pricing (FTP), namely the internal pricing of banks, is gradually adopting the LPR as the major reference, thus promoting the integration of market and benchmark lending rates for banks internal pricing. Outside banks, with the implicit floor of lending rates completely abolished, the transmission efficiency of interest rates has been significantly improved. Owing to the increasingly importance of LPR in guiding the movements of interest rates, the loan interest rates continued to decline at a pace faster than that of the LPR of the same period, thus facilitating the integration of market and benchmark lending rates for external loan pricing. Fourth, the LPR reform has played an important role in promoting the market-oriented deposit rate reform. We talked a lot about loans just now. With changes in the lending rates, the market-oriented deposit rate reform has also been advanced. Against the backdrop of LPR reform, which notably reduced the loan interest rates, with an aim of matching asset incomes, banks will reasonably reduce the costs of liabilities via lowering deposit interest rates. In fact, as the benchmark deposit rate 3688110/3688175/4087230/index.html 13/18 26/10/2021, 10:44 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Implementation of Policies for Promoting Support Extended by Financial Institutions to Real Economy remains the same, deposit pricing is still based on the benchmark rate. However, banks deposit rates with different maturities have all declined recently in spite of the same benchmark deposit rate. Although the benchmark remains unchanged, the real deposit rates fell, and the medium and long-term deposit rates registered an even sharper decline. In July 2020, the weighted average interest rates of three-year and five-year deposits dropped to 3.68 percent and 3.72 percent respectively, down 4 basis points and 34 basis points from end-2019 respectively. In the same month, the weighted average rates of certificates of deposit (CDs) of large state-owned banks and joint-stock banks stood at 2.49 percent and 2.72 percent respectively, decreasing by 45 basis points and 33 basis points compared with end-2019. The yields of representative money market funds have declined to below 1.5 percent, lower than the one-year benchmark deposit interest rate. Fifth, financial structure has been optimized. The LPR reform has removed the implicit floor of lending rates and thus boosted competition in the loan market. Under this condition, large enterprises could enjoy lower lending rates from commercial banks due to their bargaining power to push down lending rates. This would curtail the benefits that commercial banks can reap from prioritizing the businesses with large enterprises, driving them to reach out to MSBs by offering services and actively enhancing support for them. This could lead to increase in volume, expansion in coverage and drop in price with regard to MSB financing. I mentioned relevant statistics just now. Outstanding MSB loans grew by 27.5 percent year on year, marking an increase in volume at end-July. Besides, as banks were more motivated to serve MSBs, competition was intensified, which pushed prices down accordingly. The interest rates of new inclusive MSB loans in June averaged 5.08 percent, 0.8 percentage points lower than end-2019. On the whole, the LPR reform has delivered remarkable results in driving down the lending rates. In July 2020, the weighted average lending rate of enterprises stood at 4.68 percent, a year-on-year drop of 0.64 percentage points, which 3688110/3688175/4087230/index.html 14/18 26/10/2021, 10:44 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Implementation of Policies for Promoting Support Extended by Financial Institutions to Real Economy was sharper than the decline of the one-year LPR during the same period. Next, the PBC will, in line with the arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, continue to deepen the LPR reform and facilitate the integration of market and benchmark lending rates. To that end, with the improvement in LPR transmission mechanism, the PBC will encourage financial institutions to further incorporate LPR into their loan FTP, namely, banks internal funds transfer pricing curve, and enhance the co-movement between both internal and external loan pricing and the LPR. Solid efforts will be made to improve the policy rate system of the central bank which employs the interest rates of open market operations as the short-term policy rates and those of MLFs as the medium-term policy rates, so as to guide the market rates to move around the central banks policy rates. Thank you. 3688110/3688175/4087230/index.html 15/18 26/10/2021, 10:44 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Implementation of Policies for Promoting Support Extended by Financial Institutions to Real Economy 3688110/3688175/4087230/index.html 16/18 26/10/2021, 10:44 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Implementation of Policies for Promoting Support Extended by Financial Institutions to Real Economy Date of last update SEP. 05, 2020 3688110/3688175/4087230/index.html 17/18 26/10/2021, 10:44 Deputy Governor Liu Guoqiang Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Implementation of Policies for Promoting Support Extended by Financial Institutions to Real Economy 3688110/3688175/4087230/index.html 18/18

Title: State Council Policy Briefing on 'Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy'
text: 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy To Read Chinese Version The State Council Information Office held a routine policy briefing at 10 a.m. on Monday, September 14, 2020. Present at the briefing were Pan Gongsheng, Deputy Governor of the Peoples Bank of China (PBC) and Administrator of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and officials from the Ministry of Justice. They briefed the press on the access rules set for financial holding companies (FHCs) to better serve the real economy and answered their questions. The selected transcript is as follows, which covers only the remarks of PBC Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng. Pan Gongsheng: Friends from the press, good morning. Yesterday afternoon the State Council issued the Decision on Implementing Access Management of Financial Holding Companies (hereinafter referred to as the Decision) and the PBC released the Trial Measures on Regulation of Financial Holding Companies (hereinafter referred to as the Measures). At todays briefing, I will introduce to you the relevant policies. In recent years, with their rapid development in China, FHCs have played a positive role in meeting the diversified needs of different types of market entities and serving economic development. 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 1/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy However, there are also a small number of enterprises expanding blindly into the financial sector and building up risks. Highly concerned, the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee and the State Council have stressed time and again the importance of regulating comprehensive financial operation and industry-finance combination, exercising coordinated supervision over FHCs and shoring up weaknesses in the regulatory system. As a significant step to implement the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council and deepen financial reform, the release of the Decision and the Measures is conducive to regulating the management of FHCs, preventing cross-sector risk contagion and keeping order in the financial market so as to better serve the real economy and foster a virtuous cycle between the economy and the financial sector. The Decision authorizes the PBC to conduct access management and supervision of FHCs. It sets down that domestic nonfinancial enterprises, natural persons and recognized legal persons who control or have de facto control over at least two types of financial institutions and fall into any of the prescribed circumstances shall submit applications to the PBC and establish FHCs upon approval. In accordance with the Decision released by the State Council, the PBC led the formulation of the Measures to further specify access management rules and regulatory requirements for FHCs. The Measures follows macroprudential management concepts, adheres to the general principle of adopting a separate operation model, and provides for all-round, ongoing and look-through supervision over FHCs based on consolidated management so as to separate industrial businesses from financial businesses institutionally. It sets criteria for shareholder qualification, strengthens capital management, lays down requirements for a simple, clear and penetrable equity structure, regulates related party transactions, and improves corporate 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 2/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy governance as well as risk management. At the same time, a reasonable transitional period is allowed for existing companies to manage the pace and timing properly and move ahead with the implementation of the Measures in a prudent and orderly manner. Going forward, the PBC will take law-based, prudent and well-sequenced steps to carry out access management and ongoing supervision of FHCs in an open, fair and just manner, formulate supporting rules, improve the institutional framework, forestall and defuse risks, and enhance the capacity of the financial sector to serve the real economy. Thank you. Journalist with China Central Television, China Media Group: What are the background and major considerations for issuing the Decision and the Measures to conduct access management and ongoing supervision of FHCs? Thank you. Pan Gongsheng: Since the Fifth National Financial Work Conference was held in 2017, in line with the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, the PBC has been working with the Ministry of Justice and other relevant agencies to formulate rules for conducting access management and ongoing supervision of FHCs. The background and major considerations are the following. First, as we all know, despite having already existed in China, FHCs as a whole have not been put under supervision and regulation, leaving a regulatory vacuum. Over the years, with economic and financial development and the advancement of reform, some large financial institutions have made investments across sectors, giving rise to financial conglomerates. At the same time, a number of non-financial enterprises have come to hold controlling interests in multiple financial institutions of different types, giving rise to enterprises with FHC features, such as CITIC Group, China Everbright Group and China Merchants Group, which have a relatively long history, Shanghai International Group and Beijing Financial Holdings Group, which have 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 3/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy local background, and private businesses and Internet enterprises like Ant Financial. By adopting this model, many of the institutions, which are quite competitive and feature well-regulated operation, have optimized resource allocation, reduced costs, and diversified and improved financial services to better serve the needs of various enterprises and consumers and enhance the capacity of the financial sector to serve the real economy. However, there is a regulatory vacuum left as FHCs as a whole have not been subject to supervision and regulation in China. Irregularities have been arising, such as blind business expansion into the financial sector by some non-financial enterprises, complex organizational structure, hidden equity structure, cross holding of shares, revolving capital injection, and fake capital injection. Moreover, some shareholders intervene in the operations of financial institutions, and utilize related party transactions for covert transfers of interests, illicit fund acquisitions and so on, such as in Tomorrow Holdings, CEFC China Energy Co., Anbang Group and their affiliated firms. Second, to carry out law-based access management and supervision of FHCs reflects that the financial sector is a licensed industry, and it is also in line with common international practice. In the global context, as FHCs tend to have large scales, diversified businesses, high relatedness and strong risk spillover effect, the United States, Japan, Korea and Chinese Taiwan have all put in place dedicated legislation which provides for access approval and supervision of FHCs. In the wake of the 2008 global financial crisis, major countries and regions have attached more importance to holistic supervision. Primarily aimed at forestalling and defusing systemic risks, efforts have been made to reduce the complexity, contagiousness and concentration of FHC risks, leading to higher prudential supervisory standards for FHCs regarding capital adequacy, corporate governance and risk isolation. 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 4/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy Third, the Decision and the Measures, which are based on Chinas practice, have fully incorporated international experience in financial supervision to shore up weaknesses in the regulatory system. The CPC Central Committee and the State Council have stressed repeatedly that coordinated efforts need to be made to exercise supervision over FHCs and shore up regulatory weaknesses. With the implementation of the Decision and the Measures, FHCs formed via non-financial enterprises investments will be included as a whole into the supervisory framework. To adhere to the principle of adopting a separate operation model in the financial sector and separate industrial businesses from financial businesses will help prevent risk contagion across institutions, industries and markets. It will also help spur beneficial innovations by FHCs so as to better satisfy social needs for diversified, comprehensive and convenient financial services and to improve the quality and efficiency of financial services for the real economy. These are the background and major considerations for releasing the Decision and the Measures. Thank you. Journalist with Economic Daily: Will the Measures bring any changes to the current landscape of separate operation and separate supervision in China? Thank you. Pan Gongsheng: First, Chinas financial sector has adopted a structure that features separate operation and separate supervision. Being the result of long-time practice and exploration which suits the current conditions of Chinas economic and financial development, this structure should be maintained. Second, the FHC model has been adopted by most of the major economies in the world, with financial subsidiaries following the separate operation mode. As introduced in my answer to the previous question, under such a framework, equity 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 5/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy structures and organizational structures are simple, clear and easy to identify, which will help isolate risks, enhance corporate governance and risk control in the conglomerate as a whole and meet the requirements of modern financial supervision. Third, the implementation of the Measures will serve to improve and supplement the current structure of Chinas financial sector that features separate operation and separate supervision. As clearly prescribed in the Measures released by the PBC, it is up to the FHC to conduct equity investment and management, while financial businesses are conducted in a separate operation mode by financial institutions in which the FHC holds a controlling stake. The PBC will exercise holistic supervision over FHCs from a macroprudential perspective, while financial regulatory agencies will perform their respective duties to exercise separate supervision over financial institutions in which FHCs are controlling shareholders. These statements clearly show that the implementation of the Measures will improve and supplement rather than change the current structure of Chinas financial sector which features separate operation and separate supervision. Accordingly, the PBC and relevant regulators will establish an inter-agency work mechanism, enhance regulatory collaboration and information sharing, and join efforts to promote the regulated and sound development of FHCs. Thank you. Journalist with Market News International: How is work getting on to address FHC risks that have already been accumulated and exposed? Will you tell us something about the resolution of risks associated with Shanxi Lucheng Rural Commercial Bank and Deyu Group, which has been reported by the media recently? Thank you. Pan Gongsheng: Since the critical battle of forestalling and defusing financial risks was launched, financial regulatory agencies have prudently dealt with a number of conglomerates with FHC features, such as Tomorrow Holdings, Anbang Group and CEFC China Energy Co., as you can see from media reports. The resolution of Anbang Group and CEFC China Energy Co. 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 6/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy has almost come to an end, while work regarding Tomorrow Holdings is still underway. On July 17, 2020, in line with the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council as well as the requirements of the State Council Financial Stability and Development Committee (FSDC), the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (CBIRC) and the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) carried out takeovers of nine financial institutions affiliated with Tomorrow Holdings. At present, the takeovers are moving ahead in a steady and orderly manner. As to the risk incident in Shanxi that you mentioned, the Shanxi provincial government is dealing with it step by step in collaboration with financial regulatory agencies. Overall, the risks are controllable. Journalist with China National Radio, China Media Group: Could you please introduce the major principles and priorities of FHC regulation? Pan Gongsheng: According to the Measures released by the PBC, from a macroprudential perspective and based on consolidated management, we will carry out all round, continued and look-through supervision and regulation on the capital, behaviors and risks of FHCs, so as to regulate their operational behaviors and forestall risk contagion. The key points are as follows. Firstly, to carry out market access management. As a franchising industry, the financial sector should adopt strict market access requirements. Non-financial enterprises which have de facto control of at least two types of financial institutions and the types and asset sizes of which meet the conditions of stipulated circumstances should set up FHCs, which will be subject to the supervision and regulation. Secondly, to continue the separate operation in the financial sector in general. FHCs can engage in equity investment and management and conduct financial businesses through the financial institutions they control, instead of directly engaging in commercial financial activities. The financial institutions operate separately and independently from each other so as to build up firewalls against risks. Thirdly, to implement supervisory and 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 7/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy regulatory priorities centering on forestalling systemic risks. Regarding the group as a whole, the PBC will clarify the criteria for shareholder qualification, capital management, corporate governance, related party transactions, risk isolation and other aspects. Specifically, the priorities mainly fall on regulating shareholder qualification and equity management, conducting capital supervision and regulation over FHCs as a whole, regulating corporate governance and related party transactions, developing unified and all-around risk management system and sound risk firewall system of FHCs. Fourthly, to have the supervisory and regulatory responsibilities clearly defined and divided. As I have mentioned, the PBC mainly performs sustained supervision and regulation over FHCs from the perspective of macroprudential management. Other financial regulators supervise and regulate the corresponding financial institutions held by FHCs in accordance with laws and the division of responsibilities for financial supervision and regulation. In other words, the financial institutions of different types held by FHCs are supervised and regulated by respective financial regulators based on the existing division of regulatory responsibilities. At the same time, an inter-ministerial mechanism will be put in place to strengthen supervisory and regulatory collaboration and information sharing. Journalist with Phoenix TV: We noticed that some media had discussed about the possibility for commercial banks to control or set up securities companies as a pilot program. Could you please share with us the financial regulators considerations for next steps? Pan Gongsheng: Thank you for your question. We also noticed these reports by the media. I remember that relevant regulators have responded to this question. If you are interested in their reply, you may refer to the on-line information. 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 8/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy Chinas financial sector features a pattern based on separate operation and separate regulation, which is formed through long- term practices and explorations and is adaptive to Chinas economic and financial reality. Thus, the pattern should be adhered to. It is a priority for Chinas financial reform to promote healthy development of the capital market. In recent years, in line with the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, tremendous efforts have been made under the guidance of the FSDC under the State Council. The PBC will continue to work with other authorities to further promote the institutional building and innovation-driven development of Chinas capital market in accordance with the arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council. Thank you. Journalist with The Beijing News: Recently, the PBC and Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD) have held a joint meeting to communicate with key real estate enterprises. Could you please introduce the latest progress in the rules for fund supervision and financing administration of real estate enterprises? Thank you. Pan Gongsheng: In spite that this question is beyond the topic of todays conference, I will give you an introduction. As we know, after the 19th CPC National Congress, the fundamental principle for real estate market management has been clarified by the CPC Central Committee, which emphasizes houses are for living in, not for speculation, and the real estate market shall not be used to provide a short-term stimulus for the economy. The central government has maintained strategic resolve over this issue to stabilize land prices, housing prices and market expectations, with consistent and stable supervisory and regulatory policies of the real estate market. It has been reflected by the policy implementation of recent years with notable features. Currently, the development of Chinas real estate market remains sound in general. As the negative impacts 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 9/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy of COVID-19 are gradually subsiding, the sales have picked up rapidly while the recovery of development and investment has sped up, with housing prices generally stable. It took us almost two years to draft the rules for financing administration. Based on extensive opinion solicitation and broad communications with the real estate and financial sectors, the PBC and MOHURD, jointly with other relevant departments, formulated rules for fund monitoring and financing administration of key real estate enterprises. It is an essential part of the development of the long-term mechanism for the real estate market, and an important component of the financial prudential management of the real estate sector. The mechanism is aimed at establishing a more market-oriented, rule-based and transparent administration over the financing by real estate enterprises. From a micro perspective, it helps real estate enterprises to foster stable expectations for financial policies, appropriately arrange their businesses and financing activities, while correcting irrational expansion of some enterprises and encouraging them to achieve steady progress with enhanced resilience against risks. From the macro perspective, it is conducive to promoting the long-term sound development of the real estate sector as well as preventing and defusing financial risks in the sector, thus facilitating steady and healthy development of the real estate market in a sustainable manner. In fact, some real estate enterprises have begun to optimize their business strategy and financial structure since last year. When formulating the rules, we took the reality of the enterprises and the market into full consideration in an attempt to design a scientific and reasonable transitional period. Just like the Measures on FHCs, we have arranged a reasonable and scientific transitional period. In general, the rules for fund monitoring and financing administration of key real estate enterprises have witnessed a steady start and positive feedback from the society. 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 10/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy Next, we will work with MOHURD and other regulatory authorities to track and assess the implementation, continuously improve the rules and scale up the application scope in a steady manner. Thank you. Journalist with China Daily: After the promulgation of the Measures and the Decision, what specific measures will be taken by the PBC to supervise and regulate FHCs? Thanks. Pan Gongsheng: The promulgation of the Decision by the State Council yesterday and the Measures by the PBC has marked the official start of supervision and regulation of FHCs. There is still much work to do. The PBC will take law-based and orderly steps to complete all the tasks in an open, fair and just manner, in line with the requirements of the modernization of Chinas system and capacity for governance. Our major tasks in the future include: First of all, our communications with the market should be further enhanced. Today, you, friends from media, were invited here by the State Council Information Office for the policy interpretation, in hope that you could help expand the coverage of policy publicity and make more people understand the essence of this policy. In the future, such communication will be continued involving both the media and market entities. Meanwhile, during policy implementation, we could keep abreast with market situations and respond to market concerns through such communication, thus further strengthening the transparency and feasibility of policies. Second, the institutional framework will be improved. The Decision and the Measures have set up initial policy framework for FHC supervision and regulation, but they are merely a framework. The regulation of FHCs requires more specific and detailed rules in such aspects as consolidated management, capital management and related party transactions. We have made thorough preparations in these aspects earlier, and therefore the framework development is well grounded. 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 11/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy Third, the market access management will be carried out. According to the Decision released by the State Council yesterday, the PBC will accept and review the applications for establishment of FHCs from eligible enterprises and provide administrative licensing services. Fourth, transition will be introduced in a prudent and orderly manner. Some existing companies have the features of FHCs already and meet the conditions for setting up FHCs. However, they might fail to meet the requirements of the Measures in terms of ownership structure. To tackle this, we set a reasonable transitional period with reference to the practices of the US and Japan. In this transitional period, differentiated measures will be taken for existing companies to smoothly advance the implementation of the Measures. Fifth, routine supervision and regulation will be continuously conducted. The PBC will, in line with the principle of macroprudential management, enhance supervisory and regulatory collaboration with other relevant authorities to guide the FHCs to operate in line with laws and regulations, improve their corporate governance, effectively forestall risks and enhance the capability to serve the high quality development of the real economy. 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 12/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy 1 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 13/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy Date of last update SEP. 23, 2020 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 14/15 26/10/2021, 10:40 Deputy Governor Pan Gongsheng Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Specifying Access Rules for Financial Holding Companies to Serve the Real Economy 3688110/3688175/4102027/index.html 15/15

Title: State Council Policy Briefing onImproving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System
text: 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System To Read Chinese Version The State Council Information Office held a regular press briefing at 3 p.m. on December 25, 2020 (Friday). Lian Weiliang, Vice Chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), and Chen Yulu, Deputy Governor of the Peoples Bank of China (PBC), introduced what has been done to improve the mechanism for deterring acts of bad faith and to enhance the social credit system, and answered questions from the press. Selected transcript is as follows. Chen Yulu: Dear friends from the press, the credit reference system is a core component of the social credit system, and the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and the State Council have attached great importance to the building of the credit reference system. Since the 18th CPC National Congress, resolutely implementing the decisions and arrangements made by the CPC Central Committee, the PBC has upheld the fundamental philosophy of facilitating credit reference services for the benefit of the people, pushed ahead with the development of Chinas credit reference system in a 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 1/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System market-oriented, law-based and technology-enabled way, and kept improving the mechanism for deterring acts of bad faith. The efforts delivered positive results. At present, the National Financial Credit Information Basic Database, the establishment of which was led by the PBC, is the worlds largest credit reference system. Meanwhile, the commercial and consumer credit information collected independently by market-based credit reference agencies, namely the non-credit information, has also become an important component of Chinas credit reference system. In terms of effects, the credit reference system has been playing an increasingly prominent role in preventing and defusing major financial risks, serving the real economy, improving the business environment and enhancing the publics awareness of credit. As we know, the World Banks Doing Business report includes a credit-based index, namely the depth of credit information index. China has been given full credit for the index for four consecutive years. At the beginning of the year, the PBC launched the second-generation credit reference system, further improving its services, security and convenience. At the same time, in order to address the financing difficulties that many micro and small businesses (MSBs) short of credit records may face in their first financing attempt due to information asymmetry, the PBC has proactively encouraged the establishment of market-oriented credit reference platforms across China, guided market-based credit reference agencies to innovate their services, forged Taizhou experience in Zhejiang Province and Suzhou experience in Jiangsu Province by using non-credit alternative data, and applied the experience nationwide. All these endeavors have produced desirable results. During the critical period of pandemic containment this year, adhering to the principle that the interests of the people come before all else, the PBC has tackled various difficulties faced by enterprises in their efforts to contain the pandemic and resume work and production and, in particular, contibuted to credit information services for facilitating the financing of 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 2/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). Up to now, the PBCs credit reference system has exempted nearly RMB1 billion of charges and fees for credit report inquiries. The PBCs platform for financing secured by receivables has helped MSMEs secure nearly RMB2 trillion of financing, more than doubling its annual target of RMB800 billion. Meanwhile, the PBC has also taken proactive measures to optimize and adjust credit reference policies, which effectively safeguarded the credit information rights and interests of four categories of people who are directly affected by the pandemic. The measures were warmly received by the public. Our international counterparts in charge of credit reference, such as those in the EU, the US and other countries, have learned from our experience. Next, the PBC will thoroughly implement the guidelines of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee and the recent Central Economic Work Conference, and act in accordance with the arrangements made by the State Council executive meetings. We will stick to the rules of developing credit reference system, increase effective supply of credit reference services, optimize the market of credit reference services, further improve the mechanism for deterring acts of bad faith, and accelerate the building of a modern credit reference system adaptive to the digital era, so as to make due contributions to the high-quality economic and social development of China. This is my introduction. Questions are welcomed. Thank you. Journalist with China News Service: The past few years have seen the rapid development of third-party credit reference agencies which provide credit information services for enterprises and individuals. Not long ago, the PBC made public its decision to issue the second license for personal credit information businesses for public scrutiny. Deputy Governor Chen, could you tell us how the PBC will foster and administrate the credit information market? Thanks. 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 3/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System Chen Yulu: Thank you. You have raised a very important issue. The credit information market indeed requires fostering, and it is the only way for a country to develop a modern credit reference system. Throughout the two-century history of the global credit information industry, the development patterns vary by countries and regions. Therefore, while drawing on international experience, we must take Chinas credit culture as the basis to create our own development pattern of the credit information market. However, this needs in-depth and sustained exploration. It is safe to say that after growing for more than a decade, Chinas credit information market has been developing its own characteristics, and making greater contributions to serving the real economy and MSBs as well as enhancing the peoples awareness of integrity in the entire society. To be more specific, with the transition of the Chinese economy and society to high-quality development as well as the widespread application of new information technologies, more evidence shows that Chinas credit information market will march into a golden era, which must not be missed. Therefore, to remain committed to market-oriented, law-based and science and technology-enabled development, we must regulate the market development while encouraging innovations, and promote the sharing of credit information services while strictly ensuring information security, especially the safety of personal information. To meet the higher demands for a modernized credit information industry, we need to cope with some new issues with regard to the development of the credit information market. They can be summarized in three aspects: The first is to tighten regulation. Since the credit information business is centered on the information, which involves the protection of the peoples information rights and interests, we must put information security and the protection of rights and interests in the first place in our regulatory practices. In accordance with requirements laid out in laws and regulations such as the Civil Code and Regulations on the Administration of Credit Information Industry, the PBC will continue to improve the 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 4/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System measures on the administration of credit information business, incorporate all information services aimed at serving financial and economic activities and used for assessing the credit status of enterprises and individuals into credit information regulation, and exercise licensing management. Any illegal engagement in credit information business will be investigated and punished in accordance with relevant laws and regulations. As was noted at the State Council executive meeting held on November 25 this year, we should advance the market access of personal credit reference agencies in a steady way. The second license for personal credit information business, as you have just mentioned, was granted based on this principle, and we will make sure that only licensed agencies can provide personal credit information services. The second is to strengthen supply. While continuing to improve the PBCs second- generation credit reporting system, we need to deepen the supply-side structural reform, guide private capital and other social forces to develop the market-oriented credit reference agencies in an orderly manner. We also need to achieve the inter-connectivity and information sharing among market-based credit reference agencies by means of the technologies of blockchain and big data and in marketoriented approaches, so as to facilitate the establishment of a comprehensive evaluation system for the credit status of enterprises. As part of the move to promote the high-quality integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta region, the PBC has been pushing forward credit information integration in the region. To be more specific, we are trying to realize credit information inter-connectivity among local market-based credit reference agencies through new technologies and rules, and have made encouraging progress in this regard. Meanwhile, we will stay committed to high-level opening-up and thus encourage open competition to increase high-level credit information supply, so as to enhance the international competitiveness of domestic credit reference agencies. 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 5/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System The third is to ensure security. We will ensure the security of the network environment and the technological architecture of various credit reporting systems. Besides, we will also take measures to enhance the protection of credit information, especially personal credit information. The 14th Five-Year Plan period will be crucial to Chinas economic transformation and high-quality development, as well as a golden period for the development of the credit information industry. We have every confidence to seize the opportunity and bring Chinas credit information market to a new height. Thank you. Journalist with Red Star News: For the time being, Chinas individual credit system has yet to be well-established, and relevant departments sometimes find it difficult to fully grasp the financial status of individuals, which give rise to the phenomenon of maliciously escaping debts after enterprise bankruptcies. How to address this problem? Thank you. Chen Yulu: This is an issue that concerns the public greatly. Id like to invite Director-General Wan Cunzhi of the Credit Information System Bureau of the PBC to answer your question. Wan Cunzhi: People are quite concerned about this issue. Currently, we are studying whether credit reporting systems could collect property-related information as much as possible to reflect individuals repayment ability and their credit status. The PBC, in line with the decisions and arrangements of the central authority, is striving to establish an allinclusive credit reference system. Our goal is to realize the inter-connectivity and sharing of credit information among the financial sector, the government departments and relevant enterprise sectors with the support of new technologies. 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 6/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System The problem you put forward will be readily addressed with the gradual establishment and improvement of the all-inclusive credit reference system. During this process, since the collection of individual property information is restricted, according to the Regulation on the Administration of Credit Investigation Industry, credit investigation institutions shall be authorized to collect property information of an individual only after the individual concerned is clearly informed of possible consequences of such information collection and grants an explicit consent. The procedures will be carried out based on laws and regulations, so that property-related information will be collected in an appropriate manner and the credit status of individuals will be comprehensively assessed. Thank you. Journalist with China Daily: Today, the abuse of personal information still widely exists in society. People are worried about privacy leakage. What measures will be taken to strengthen the protection of personal credit information in the future? Thank you. Chen Yulu: The sharing and protection of credit information are two opposing ends, but we must integrate these two. Strengthening the protection of personal information and ensuring the security of credit information is the bottom line in our work on credit information, which relates to safeguarding peoples information rights and interests. The PBC has focused on the following four aspects in credit information regulation: First, the PBC has required the Credit Reference Center to put data security at the forefront. Since the beginning of developing its credit reporting system, we have tried every means to organize a high-quality information security team. In the process of developing and upgrading the second-generation system, information security has also been put first. Therefore, 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 7/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System data security has been continuously improved. The security performance of the system has been recognized by international counterparts and the World Bank delegation. Second, the PBC has further strengthened the regulation of information security and personal information protection in the credit investigation market. On one hand, we have guided financial institutions to effectively protect customers personal financial information, regulated their business activities and strengthened their awareness of personal information protection and legal compliance. On the other hand, for financial institutions, credit investigation institutions, and relevant persons held accountable for information leakage or even illegal reselling of client data, severe punishment will be meted out in accordance with the law to form regulatory deterrent. In addition, the PBC has cooperated with relevant departments to crack down on the illegal purchase and sale of personal information in the name of big data companies or big data credit investigation, and to punish fraudulent behaviors in the name of credit information services and corporate credit reporting services. Third, the PBC has vigorously carried out credit information publicity and education programs. Nowadays, some people say they can clean up credit reports or remove bad credit records for others. Vigorous publicity programs must be conducted to expose these online scams, so as to help the people avoid being defrauded. Fourth, the PBC has continuously improved credit information rules and regulations to consolidate legal base for the protection of personal information. China is formulating a law on personal information protection and a law on data security. In 2013, the State Council promulgated the Regulation on the Administration of Credit Investigation Industry for implementation, which gave information subjects the rights to know, consent, raise dispute and file complaint. That made a milestone in protecting the legitimate rights and interests of information subjects. 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 8/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System Next, we will introduce the Interim Measures on the Protection of Personal Financial Information in due course based on the upcoming laws such as the law on personal information protection and the law on data security. We will enhance our efforts to ensure legal use of personal information in the financial area, and to effectively safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of information subjects. Thank you. Journalist with CCTV Business Channel, China Central Television, China Media Group: We have noticed that the default of corporate debenture bonds in the bond market recently caused widespread concern in the market. What measures will be forthcoming in cracking down on evading debts and ensuring the rule of law in the bond market? Thank you. Chen Yulu: Since the beginning of this year, the bond market has been generally stable. Recently, a very small number of bond issuers have defaulted in the interbank bond market, triggering some fluctuations in the bond market. At present, stability has been restored and investors are becoming more rational. Objectively speaking, bond defaults reflect that rigid payment has been broken in the development of the bond market. Through the test of default data, a competitive mechanism for the survival of the fittest can be formed in the bond market. This is conducive to credit building in Chinas financial market. However, in this process, we must be highly vigilant against the disclosure of false information by defaulting enterprises, or other illegal activities like fraudulent issuance and even evading debts. Such conducts will have a devastating effect on the social environment and the credit quality of the financial market. Next, the PBC will work with the NDRC, CSRC and other relevant departments to fulfill regulatory responsibilities, further strengthen the rule of law in the bond market, tighten market discipline, and crack down on various violations of laws and 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 9/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System regulations. At the same time, we will also strengthen the information disclosure requirements, and improve the credit constraint mechanism and credit rating system, so as to enable healthier development of the credit system of the financial market, especially the bond market. Thank you. Journalist with Economic Daily: The regulators have been working hard to promote the financing of MSMEs, and the credit information is an important part of MSBs financing. May I ask what measures the PBC will take to improve the financing and credit information services for MSBs? Thank you. Chen Yulu: Youve mentioned a prominent and core issue. To promote MSBs financing, I believe the most fundamental thing is to solve the problem of information asymmetry. In other words, before lending to MSBs, financial institutions need to use various information to judge whether the principal and interest can eventually be repaid on schedule. Credit information is an important means to solve or alleviate information asymmetry. To tackle this major issue, the PBC has concentrated on three aspects in improving the financing and credit information services for MSBs in accordance with the arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council. First, we have given full play to the fundamental role of the PBCs credit reporting systems in effectively alleviating the financing difficulties of MSBs. As is shown by the statistics, MSBs account for as much as 60 percent of the total number of inquiries in the credit reporting systems of the PBC, and therefore are the biggest beneficiaries of the credit reporting systems. During the pandemic of this year, the PBCs credit reporting system has reduced and waived inquiry fees by nearly RMB1 billion, of which nearly 60 percent was enjoyed by more than 2.7 million MSBs. 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 10/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System Second, through the establishment of a platform for financing secured by receivables and a unified registration and publicity system for financing secured by chattel, the financing costs of MSBs have been effectively reduced. To assist MSBs in the supply chain with financing, the PBC began to establish the platform for financing secured by receivables in 2013, mainly to provide registration services for confirmation of account receivables pledge of MSBs online supply chain financing. Since the beginning of this year, this platform has contributed nearly RMB2 trillion to MSMEs financing, and the size of financing realized through the platform is still growing continuously and rapidly. I should say that, its support for MSMEs financing during the pandemic has been more than expected. On January 1, 2021, upon the approval of the State Council, the unified registration system for financing secured by chattel will be officially launched nationwide. In accordance with the Civil Code, the PBC will provide better services of chattel pledge and guarantee of rights for MSBs in a wider range and broader fields. Third, new technologies and alternative data are used to guide market-oriented credit investigation institutions to innovate the models of credit information services and deepen credit information services for MSBs. The World Bank defines alternative data as credit data other than borrowing information. Using alternative data to profile the credit status of enterprises and individuals is a new trend that has emerged worldwide in recent years. The main background to this is the wide application of Internet platforms and big data technology, which makes it possible to collect a large number of valid alternative data. Many MSBs were originally blank accounts or quasi-blank accounts with regard to credit information when they had no borrowing information. Under these circumstances, the credit information supply through valid alternative data will make it possible for a great number of such MSBs to obtain financing. Moreover, these marketoriented credit investigation institutions that provide alternative data can further realize the inter-connectivity of credit 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 11/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System information through new technologies such as blockchain, and thus help MSBs to obtain credit information services in a timely manner. This will be a greater contribution. This vision is highly likely to become reality. As mentioned earlier, with the Yangtze River Delta as the base, we are effectively advancing this initiative. Looking into the future, we believe that more and more MSBs will receive better and higher-quality credit information services and financing support through these three integrated approaches. Thank you. 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 12/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 13/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 14/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 15/16 26/10/2021, 10:39 PBC Deputy Governor Chen Yulu Attends State Council Policy Briefing on Improving the Mechanism for Deterring Acts of Bad Faith and Enhancing the Social Credit System Date of last update DEC. 31, 2020 3688110/3688175/4156944/index.html 16/16

Title: China's Monetary Policy to Prioritize Stability and Continuously Invigorate Market Entities Governor Talks About Hot Financial Topics in 2021
text: 26/10/2021, 10:39 Chinas Monetary Policy to Prioritize Stability and Continuously Invigorate Market Entitiesbr PBC Governor Yi Gang Talks About Hot Financial Topics in 2021 Chinas Monetary Policy to Prioritize Stability and Continuously Invigorate Market Entities PBC Governor Yi Gang Talks About Hot Financial Topics in 2021 To Read Chinese Version 2021 is the opening year of Chinas 14th Five-year Plan. As China is the only major economy worldwide reporting a positive economic growth, every move in its financial policies will be closely watched. What will be the direction of Chinas monetary policy this year? How will it continuously invigorate market entities? How to build a stronger financial safety net? Governor Yi Gang of the Peoples Bank of China (PBC) recently had an interview with Xinhua News Agency on the hot financial topics in 2021. Monetary policy will prioritize stability. It was noted at the Central Economic Work Conference that macro policy should remain continuous, stable and sustainable. In 2021, how will the PBC effectively practice the sound monetary policy to sustain necessary support for economic recovery? 3688110/3688175/4165342/index.html 1/9 26/10/2021, 10:39 Chinas Monetary Policy to Prioritize Stability and Continuously Invigorate Market Entitiesbr PBC Governor Yi Gang Talks About Hot Financial Topics in 2021 In 2021, the monetary policy will prioritize stability to maintain normal monetary policy space. Governor Yi stated that in terms of the aggregates, the PBC will employ a mix of monetary policy tools to keep liquidity adequate at a reasonable level and ensure that the growth of broad money supply (M2) and aggregate financing to the real economy (AFRE) is generally in line with nominal GDP growth. Structurally, the PBC will well leverage the role of monetary policy tools in providing targeted liquidity, and increase financial support for key responsibilities including scientific and technological innovation, micro and small businesses (MSBs) and green development. Meanwhile, the PBC will deepen the market-oriented reform of interest rates and exchange rates, consolidate the progress achieved in lowering real lending rates, and enhance the flexibility of the RMB exchange rate. The special and provisional policies exercised during the pandemic will be withdrawn once they complete their mission. How will the PBC avoid the undesirable reinforcing effect of policy withdrawal? In this regard, Yi Gang held that China has not adopted zero or negative interest rates, nor has it employed quantitative easing. As one of the few major economies that conduct normal monetary policy, it has never resorted to indiscriminate massive stimulus. Therefore, there will be less of a problem with Chinas monetary policy withdrawal. The macro leverage ratio is expected to resume a basically stable growth path. Due to the pandemic, the first half of 2020 saw a temporary rise of Chinas macro leverage ratio. How will the PBC strike a balance between economic recovery and risk prevention in the new year? 3688110/3688175/4165342/index.html 2/9 26/10/2021, 10:39 Chinas Monetary Policy to Prioritize Stability and Continuously Invigorate Market Entitiesbr PBC Governor Yi Gang Talks About Hot Financial Topics in 2021 From the macro perspective, we need to stabilize the macro leverage ratio. Yi Gang noted that, in 2020, GDP growth was relatively low due to pandemic shocks, which resulted in a significant increase in Chinas macro leverage ratio, namely the ratio of total debt to GDP. Since the third quarter of 2020, the growth of the macro leverage ratio started to slow, and is expected to return to a basically stable path this year. Yi Gang stressed that the PBC will focus on preventing the accumulation of financial risks while supporting the development of the real economy. It will prudently resolve risks of both individual institutions and key areas, improve the institutional system for the prevention, early-warning, resolution and accountability of financial risks, further ensure that all parties concerned fulfill their responsibilities, and shore up weak links in the regulatory system. Risks will be resolved in a legal, compliant, prudent and orderly manner. The PBC will improve the long-term mechanism for risk resolution and help small and medium-sized banks replenish their capital through multiple channels. It will enhance the oversight of financial activities, and investigate and punish violations of laws and regulations. Proper support will be provided to the real economy, especially MSBs. The financial system has always been concerned about the development of market entities such as MSBs and self-employed businesses. The goal of lowering profits by RMB1.5 trillion in favor of the real economy has been accomplished in 2020. How would you deliver more inclusive financial services this year, so as to better support the real economy, especially MSBs? Yi Gang said that the financial sector will further enhance the systems and mechanisms needed to provide effective financial support for the real economy, act in accordance with market-oriented, law-based and international principles, 3688110/3688175/4165342/index.html 3/9 26/10/2021, 10:39 Chinas Monetary Policy to Prioritize Stability and Continuously Invigorate Market Entitiesbr PBC Governor Yi Gang Talks About Hot Financial Topics in 2021 improve the modern financial system that features great adaptability, competitiveness and inclusiveness as well as the mechanism of incentives and constraints, design and innovate structural monetary policy tools, and continue to extend proper support to the real economy, especially MSBs. The PBC will focus on the following four aspects in its work this year. The PBC will continue to implement the support instrument for the deferral of inclusive loans to MSBs and the support scheme for unsecured inclusive loans for MSBs while keeping the amount of support unchanged. The inclusive policy of central bank lending and central bank discount will be continued to guide financial institutions to provide stronger support for agriculture, rural areas and rural people, as well as MSBs and private enterprises and other areas. The PBC will continuously carry out the project of enhancing the ability of commercial banks to provide financial services to micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), support the banks to increase loan issuance to agriculture, rural areas and rural people as well as MSBs and the manufacturing sector. Banks will also be encouraged to comprehensively evaluate the MSBs credit risks and reduce their reliance on collaterals and guarantees. The PBC will continue to leverage the leading role of the support instrument for bond financing of private enterprises, support banks to issue special financial bonds for MSBs, promote the confirmation of supply chain bills and account receivables and facilitate bond financing by enterprises. It will guide the market to launch more supply chain financial products and support the financing of upstream and downstream MSBs in the industrial chain. The PBC will improve the system of financial services in rural areas. Financial services will be leveraged to effectively connect the consolidation of achievements in the tough battle against poverty and promote its effective linkage with the rural revitalization strategy, so as to maintain the overall stability of financial assistance policies for regions out of poverty. Credit 3688110/3688175/4165342/index.html 4/9 26/10/2021, 10:39 Chinas Monetary Policy to Prioritize Stability and Continuously Invigorate Market Entitiesbr PBC Governor Yi Gang Talks About Hot Financial Topics in 2021 supply to the seed industry and other key areas in agriculture will be bolstered. The PBC will also expand the scope of collaterals and pledges for agriculture and rural areas, optimize the risk assessment mechanism, and support the direct financing of eligible entities through equity and bonds. Market-oriented interest rate and exchange rate reforms will go deeper. The shift of the pricing benchmark for outstanding floating rate loans was completed in 2020, and the movement of the RMB exchange rate has aroused much attention recently. What measures will be introduced in 2021 to advance market-oriented interest rate and exchange rate reforms? Yi Gang said that the PBC will further smooth the transmission of the loan prime rates (LPRs) to lending rates, and gradually marketize deposit rates by deepening the LPR reform. It will strengthen the management of online platform deposits and cross-regional deposits to maintain deposit market order and stabilize banks liability costs. Meanwhile, the central bank policy rate system and the money market benchmark rates will be further improved. The RMB exchange rate became more flexible in 2020, effectively playing its role as an automatic stabilizer for the macro economy and the balance of payments and enabling a more independent monetary policy as well. The appreciation of the RMB last year, Yi Gang noted, was mainly a reflection of Chinas economic fundamentals. As the first country in the world to contain the pandemic successfully and thus to resume work and production and see positive growth, China has had better fundamentals than other major economies. At the same time, the strengthening of the RMB has to do with the decline in the US dollar index. 3688110/3688175/4165342/index.html 5/9 26/10/2021, 10:39 Chinas Monetary Policy to Prioritize Stability and Continuously Invigorate Market Entitiesbr PBC Governor Yi Gang Talks About Hot Financial Topics in 2021 In 2021, the market will continue to play a decisive role in the formation of the RMB exchange rate, and the allocation of financial resources will be further optimized. The PBC will stick to a managed floating exchange rate regime and attach importance to guiding expectations, thereby keeping the RMB exchange rate basically stable at an adaptive and equilibrium level. High-level opening-up of the financial sector will move ahead. Over the past year, China kept up its pace of financial market opening-up despite the pandemic, with Fitch Ratings becoming the second international credit rating company to enter the Chinese market and a timetable in place for the inclusion of Chinese bonds in FTSE Russell indices. Next, what will the PBC do to move ahead with high-level financial opening-up? The opening-up of the financial sector is essential for the establishment of the new development paradigm. What to do next, Yi Gang said, is to fully implement the management system of pre-establishment national treatment plus a negative list, transform our perceptions of opening-up, and promote systemic and institutional opening-up. More work will be done to improve supporting rules in financial fields and align regulatory models and systems with international practice. The openingup of the financial sector, the reform of the RMB exchange rate formation mechanism, and RMB internationalization will be advanced in a coordinated way. And financial regulation must keep pace with the expansion of opening-up. Yi Gang stressed the importance of building a regulatory framework and a system of risk prevention and control to match higher-level opening-up. Regulatory coordination will be strengthened to forge regulatory synergy. Moreover, the monitoring of cross-border capital flows will be enhanced, and financial regulation will be more professional and effective to safeguard financial stability. 3688110/3688175/4165342/index.html 6/9 26/10/2021, 10:39 Chinas Monetary Policy to Prioritize Stability and Continuously Invigorate Market Entitiesbr PBC Governor Yi Gang Talks About Hot Financial Topics in 2021 The three functions of financial support for green development will be brought into full play. The Central Economic Work Conference has set forth the tasks of peaking carbon dioxide emissions and achieving carbon neutrality. What will the financial sector do to support green development and help reach the targets? To fulfill the tasks of peaking carbon dioxide emissions and achieving carbon neutrality, Yi Gang said, China is to undergo profound changes in many ways, such as industrial structure, energy structure, investment structure, and lifestyle. One of the priorities of financial work in 2021 and for some time in the future is to provide effective support for this strategic arrangement. Green finance started quite early in China and has had a good foundation. Currently, Chinas outstanding green loans have exceeded RMB11 trillion, ranking first globally, while outstanding green bonds stand at over RMB1 trillion, the second highest in the world. In his opinion, what is most important next is to work on green finance policy design and planning so as to bring into play the three functions of financial support for green development, i.e., resource allocation, risk management, and market pricing. To this end, he called for efforts to gradually improve the five pillars of the green finance system. First, steps should be taken to improve the system of green finance standards and effectively carry out statistical work as well as assessment and supervision. Second, the regulation of financial institutions and the requirements for information disclosure should be improved so that information on carbon emissions can be disclosed to the public. Third, a system of policy incentives and constraints should be established, with more loans issued at preferential rates to carbon emission reduction programs and the risks of green assets weighted scientifically. Fourth, continued efforts should be made to improve green finance products 3688110/3688175/4165342/index.html 7/9 26/10/2021, 10:39 Chinas Monetary Policy to Prioritize Stability and Continuously Invigorate Market Entitiesbr PBC Governor Yi Gang Talks About Hot Financial Topics in 2021 and the system of green finance markets by developing products such as green loans, green bonds, and green funds, establishing carbon markets, and developing carbon futures. Fifth, international cooperation should be enhanced in the field of green finance so that relevant standards can be not only unified domestically but also aligned with international practice, and that the China-EU Shared Classification Catalogue for Green Finance will be completed preferably this year.
